The market even has its own kitchen, so it's not a problem if James forgets an ingredient - James then ditches the car to take a tour of the city's famous murals, but vehicles with more power await... Philadelphia is home to one of the most impressive car collections in the world - as a result, James gets a spin in a very special car. Philadelphia is also host to an upcoming movement of vegan eating - Charlie Was A Sinner is at the forefront of this, and James's visit allows us to see what makes a restaurant like this so popular. utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

bbc3.uk.description: A round-up of the day's news.

bbc3.uk.title: Horrible Histories
bbc3.uk.description: A Victorian woman books a ticket on a very odd railway and a modern patient is treated by a Roman dentist. Also, Alfred the Great pitches a movie about his life and a Greek geek competes on Historical Mastermind. (Comedy, Children, History) - 2012

bbc3.uk.title: Horrible Histories
bbc3.uk.description: In a special musical episode, Rattus Rattus chooses his favourite songs from the fourth series to entertain his young nephew. (Comedy, Children, History) - 2012

bbc3.uk.title: Shaun the Sheep - Specials: The Shirleyverse
bbc3.uk.description: Shaun makes a wish that changes everything, with unexpected consequences. (Comedy, Fantasy, Animated, Children) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005)
bbc3.uk.description: The village is being overrun by rabbits and Wallace has a plan to alter their minds so that they will leave the vegetable allotments alone. However, his plan goes awry and the rabbit problem escalates when the villagers discover a monstrous `were-rabbit' destroying everything in its sights. Will Wallace and Gromit be able to solve the conundrum before the creature gets shot. - 2005

bbc3.uk.title: Death in Paradise
bbc3.uk.description: A death at sea with unexplained injuries stirs rumours about a legendary sea monster, the Lusca. Meanwhile, Mervin is blindsided by an unexpected young visitor. (Crime drama, Drama, Crime) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Mrs Brown's Boys - Christmas Special Mammy's A.
bbc3.uk.description: All over Dublin, mothers are excitedly looking forward to seeing their loved ones return home for Christmas, but Agnes Brown is depressed. Her son Trevor is on the missions in Canada, and can't possibly afford to make it back. With Maria's posh mum Hillary pressing the newlyweds to spend Christmas at her place, Agnes decides to compete for their love by providing an even more lavish Christmas celebration than Hillary's. (Entertainment, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2011

bbc3.uk.title: Mrs Brown's Boys - Christmas Special: Buckin' Mammy
bbc3.uk.description: Christmas is just round the corner, and no-one knows what Bono wants for a present. He's already posted his letter off to Santa, so how can Mrs Brown find out in time? Meanwhile, at her family games night, Agnes struggles to control her temper when none of the guests will play by her rules. At least there shouldn't be any problems with the Christmas tree - she's having a very special one delivered. (Entertainment, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2013

bbc3.uk.title: Office Christmas Party (2016)
bbc3.uk.description: When the CEO tries to close her hard-partying brother's branch, he and his chief technical officer must inspire their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and save their jobs. (Comedy / Holiday) - 2016

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Learn to Drive
bbc3.uk.description: Stay-at-home-daughter Chi is suddenly forced to fend for herself when her parents die in a car crash. Chi learns she will only inherit the house on condition she completes a list of 'Things You Should Have Done' left in the parents' will, the first of which is, ironically, learn to drive. Meanwhile, Chi's highly strung auntie Karen wants nothing to do with her dependent pest of a niece, but very much wants the house she feels is rightfully hers. (Comedy, Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Get a Job
bbc3.uk.description: Chi spectacularly fails a trial period at the pharmacy with Karen, but Dave kindly lets her shadow him on his delivery rounds. On a drop-off to a retirement home Chi finds her tribe... old people. She also falls in love with Linda, an elderly lady who seems to think Chi is her husband. Elsewhere, Dave has a health scare, and Karen starts to think she might be the fertility issue. (Comedy, Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Learn to Cook
bbc3.uk.description: Pancake day is a highly sentimental time for Chi. When Dave confides in Lucas about his health scare, they vow to make the most of every moment, and that begins with pancake day. (Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Pay Your Bills
bbc3.uk.description: There's a shock for Chi when she discovers that bills are a thing and her electricity and water get cancelled. As a result, she decides she's just going to live with Auntie Karen instead. (Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Things You Should Have Done - Get Out of Kent
bbc3.uk.description: Chi looks to start a new life with Michelle in Spain, finally accepting that she's a burden to Auntie Karen. (Sitcom) - 2024

bbc3.uk.title: Doctor Who - The Witchfinders
bbc3.uk.description: The Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz arrive in 17th-century Lancashire and become embroiled in a witch trial, run by the local landowner. As fear stalks the land, the arrival of King James I only serves to intensify the witch hunt, but there could be something even more dangerous at work. (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2018

bbc3.uk.title: Doctor Who - It Takes You Away
bbc3.uk.description: On the edge of a Norwegian fjord, in the present day, The Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz discover a boarded-up cottage and a girl named Hanne in need of their help. What monster lurks in the woods around the cottage, and beyond. (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2018

bbc3.uk.title: Miranda - It Was Panning
bbc3.uk.description: Penny is threatening to cancel Miranda's Christmas if she does not sort her life out. Amongst other things, she forces her daughter on a detox. Meanwhile, Stevie has a new executive job and Miranda tries to follow her in to an office job but it all proves too much. Meanwhile, are Gary and Miranda able to just be friends. (Comedy) - 2012

bbc3.uk.title: Miranda - What a Surprise
bbc3.uk.description: Penny embarrasses Miranda by running for local councillor with Tilly as her wingman. Gary has put himself on the dating scene and Miranda decides she has to do the same - they both want dates for Stevie's birthday party. Will they find partners or end up back in each other's company? The result is a big surprise for Stevie. (Comedy) - 2013

bbc3.uk.title: Hyperdrive - Dreamgate
bbc3.uk.description: The crew discover the Dreamgate, one of the most dangerous devices in the Universe, which gives its owner the power to infiltrate other people's dreams without their knowledge. Henderson and York wander into Vine's dream of a pub in the mid-1990s, but when Vine wakes up, they become trapped inside his head. Can the rest of the crew bring them back from 1995. (Science fiction, Sitcom) - 2008

bbc3.uk.title: Hyperdrive - Convoy
bbc3.uk.description: While leading a convoy guarding Britain's new super-weapon, the ship's position is leaked and tension mounts amid suspicion of a mole on board. (Science fiction, Sitcom) - 2008

bbc3.uk.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
bbc3.uk.description: The BBC New Comedy Awards has been scouring every corner of the country to find the freshest, funniest new stand-ups around. Five more hopefuls step into the spotlight hoping to win a place in this year's grand final, where one of them will be crowned the BBC New Comedian of 2026. Mancunian comedian and podcast host Josh Jones hosts the night. (Comedy, Awards, Event, Standup) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
bbc3.uk.description: The BBC New Comedy Awards is a nationwide talent search to find the best new stand-ups Britain has to offer. For thirty years, these prestigious awards have helped launch the careers of many of the UK's best-loved comedians. This year, almost a thousand applied before being whittled down to the top 30. Tonight, five hopefuls will battle it out for a place in the BBC One grand final at Birmingham Town Hall, where one will be crowned the BBC New Comedian of 2025. (Comedy, Awards, Event, Standup) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Bagpuss
bbc3.uk.description: Mobeen receives a surprise visit from the armed police, who arrest Eight on suspicion of supplying drugs to school children in Small Heath. The real culprit is Shahid, a local dealer who has enlisted the help of his mum's cousin's cousin. (Comedy, Drama, Sitcom) - 2017

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Wifey Riddim
bbc3.uk.description: When Mobeen learns that his little sister Aks has been suspended from school for fighting, he realises he might not be the best role model. His uncles suggest that an arranged marriage might bring a much-needed female perspective into Aks's life. (Comedy, Drama, Sitcom) - 2017

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - Upper Room
bbc3.uk.description: Eight has gone missing, so Mobeen and Nate go to find him. Discovering him hiding in an abandoned den, Eight reveals that his beloved Dadha is dying and wants to see the boys one last time before he passes to the upper room. (Comedy, Drama, Sitcom) - 2018

bbc3.uk.title: Man Like Mobeen - H-ALTRight
bbc3.uk.description: Staring hate, violence and societal fractures in the face, Mobeen and his crew see the far right at an anti-Islam demonstration. After Aks throws a flask and hits their leader square in the face, Mobeen takes the blame and is subsequently arrested. (Comedy, Drama, Sitcom) - 2018

bbc4.uk.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas - The Room in the Tower
bbc4.uk.description: The BBC's 2025 ghost story for Christmas, Mark Gatiss's adaptation of EF Benson's The Room in the Tower. When he asks if she dreams, he begins to recount the haunting vision that has followed him for most of his life: a recurring dream of a mysterious house, a silent family on the lawn and an unseen, unidentified terror lurking in the room in the tower. (Drama, Horror) - 2025

bbc4.uk.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas - Woman of Stone
bbc4.uk.description: In her final days, Edith Nesbit recounts the chilling tale of newlywed Victorians Jack and Laura. As they settle into a small cottage in a quiet village, they soon find their idyll overshadowed by the superstitious warnings of their housekeeper and the legend of two marble tomb effigies who are said to rise each year and walk. Jack dismisses this is as mere folklore. But as the fateful night draws near, he makes a terrifying discovery. And back at the cottage, Laura is all alone.. (Drama, Horror) - 2024

At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The One Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 06/11/2026 Topical magazine-style programme that showcases stories of all varieties from all over the UK, ranging from the comic to the tragic, as well as interviews with guest stars.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Return to Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E1 Stilled Life Resident wedding ruiner Mackenzie Clarke is paying the price for Glenn's absence. With Phil offside and a disastrous first impression made with new pathologist Leo, she's not winning any popularity contests in Dolphin Cove. So when an artist dies on stage in front of an audience during an avant-garde performance piece for the local art fair, Mackenzie is dismayed to find that their main suspect, the victim's muse, has a surprising and complicated connection to her. Murder mystery, starring Anna Samson.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Return to Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E2 Built to Kill Solitary Mackenzie Clarke reckons with the arrival of her uninhibited house guest. When a happy-go-lucky builder dies after falling from the roof of a construction site, she is immediately on the case. Mack knows a bodged-up job when she sees it. This was no accident, this was murder. The further Mack digs, the more she uncovers: a history of debt blackmail, illicit trysts and buried secrets.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Have I Got News for You
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S72 E6 Steph McGovern hosts as guest panellist journalist Helen Lewis joins team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton for a satirical look at the news of the week.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Ten

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Graham Norton Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S34 E7 Together on Graham's sofa are Oscar-winner Judi Dench, discussing her memoir Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It?, actor Alan Cumming, returning to the UK stage in My Fair Lady, Tramell Tillman, who stars in the new Christmas Carol adaptation Ebenezer, and Derry Girls and Bridgerton star Nicola Coughlan, in powerful new drama I Am Helen. With music by James Blunt, performing his current single Circles.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E10 It's the grand finale, and the time has come for the competition to conclude as the queens compete in their final challenge - an all-singing, all-dancing extravaganza to fight for the crown. Choreographer Claudimar Neto coaches the queens as they perform a megamix of Drag Race UK's most iconic girl group songs. Michelle Visage, Alan Carr and Graham Norton form the judging panel, while last year's winner and reigning champion Bones drops by along with this season's eliminated queens.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Simply Nigella
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 Food writer Nigella Lawson demonstrates dishes that combine the comfort of the familiar with the excitement of the new, including fluffy oat pancakes drizzled with a raspberry and honey syrup. She offers a twist on a classic Caesar salad for a light lunch idea, and rustles up a Greek-inspired supper for friends including squid and orzo pasta, and a sweet and savoury version of a cheesecake. Nigella's simple rice bowl with ginger, radish and avocado celebrates a few choice ingredients and results in a dish that's uplifting to look at, as well as to eat.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S69 E16 Celebrating Soaps Donna Edwards and Dyfan Rees take on fellow actors Sera Cracroft and Sophie Mensah in an edition celebrating 50 years of Welsh language drama Pobol y Cwm, with help from experts Izzie Balmer and Kate Bliss. Danny Sebastian hosts, and also meets Steve Marshall, who has spent 40 years building a collection of memorabilia from EastEnders, Emmerdale, Coronation Street and other long-running dramas.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E64 Martin Roberts and Jacqui Joseph visit a former Victorian miner's cottage in County Durham that's due a makeover and a former school in Royal Tunbridge Wells who new owners have ambitious renovation plans. Plus, a terraced house in Basildon.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E44 Berkshire and Hampshire Sonali Shah's property know-how helps an escapee, who has her sister on hand for moral support, find the ideal rural retreat. Sonali also gets to meet some very sleepy baby barn owls and learns what needs to be done to protect these birds.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need 2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven present this year's Countryfile Ramble for Children in Need, which takes place in the Peak District. They walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future.

First up are Rick Edwards, Mollie Pearce, Molly Rainford, La Voix and Roman's sister, Harley Moon Kemp.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E13 Week 7 2026 After the fun of Halloween and the excitement of the three-way dance-off, the couples show off another routine, hoping to impress the judges and viewers - although sadly Jaime Winstone is missing this week through injury. The contestants will be working hard to stay as far away from the bottom of the leaderboard as possible - but as the series has proved so far, that's no guarantee of avoiding the dance-off. Presented by Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: Senior members of the Royal Family join veterans, serving personnel and their families at London's Royal Albert Hall for The Royal British Legion's annual remembrance concert. The evening features performances from Alfie Boe, James Emmanuel, Mica Paris, Rita Wilson and Tom Odell, alongside the Band of Royal Air Force Regiment and the Bands of HM Royal Marines Portsmouth (Royal Band) and Collingwood.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: War Horse
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Steven Spielberg's adaptation of Michael Morpurgo's First World War drama, starring Emily Watson, David Thewlis and Jeremy Irvine. Dartmoor, 1914: when Ted Narracott buys a thoroughbred horse for his farm, his son Albert soon bonds with the animal who he names Joey. However, when the harvest fails and war is declared on Germany, Ted is forced to sell Joey to the British Army. Albert enlists but can he and Joey survive the horrors of the Front to be reunited.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Planet Earth: A Tale of Three Bears
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E1 Julia Bradbury and wildlife expert Lynn Rogers explore the Northwoods of Minnesota, following three black bear cubs and learning the dangers they face in the wild. itv1anglia.uk.title: Lingo

The pair then take a boat trip, during which they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E17 Salem The chef explores Salem, Massachusetts, which was made famous by the witch trials of 1692. He visits a unique spice shop, where he picks up some ingredients to cook with, and also meets a seafood artist and makes a stop at Turner's, a family-run seafood business.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Italy v South Africa
itv1anglia.uk.description: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Scotland v New Zealand
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E21 Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Wales v Japan
itv1anglia.uk.description: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts.

Then, he pays a visit to seafood restaurant The Dock House in Sag Harbour, where he samples their famous chowder.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure

James then takes a tour of the city's famous murals, sees one of the most impressive car collections in the world and hears about the rise of vegan eating restaurants in the city.

James taps into this by visiting Amber Waves Farm, where he borrows their outdoor pizza oven to cook for the farmers using seasonal local produce. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvlondon.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Philadelphia
itvlondon.uk.description: James visits Philadelphia. `The City of Brotherly Love' is the perfect backdrop for his foodie adventure, with Reading Terminal Market providing all manner of ingredients for both of his cooks. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvlondon.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvlondon.uk.description: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

itvlondon.uk.title: ITV News
itvlondon.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvlondon.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvlondon.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are racing hero Billy Monger and Gavin and Stacey's Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvlondon.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Talking Royals
itvlondon.uk.description: A round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

itvlondon.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itvlondon.uk.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as four stars - Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Akines-Aryeetey - take on each other in the first-ever four-way cooking battle. They'll have to produce stand-out dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two stars who impress the most go straight through to the quarter-finals, and the losing stars will have to impress the world-class chefs and cook again in the cook-off - where one will leave the competition. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: ITV News
itvlondon.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvlondon.uk.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas - Flavour Foundations Bahamian Classics
itvlondon.uk.description: Ainsley kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp, before wrapping things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw. (Cookery) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Australia
itvlondon.uk.description: England resume their Nations Championship campaign as they entertain Australia at the Allianz Stadium, Twickenham. After suffering a chastening defeat at the hands of South Africa in Johannesburg in July, Steve Borthwick's side chalked up a comfortable win over Fiji and a slender one over Argentina and now face an improving Australian side. The Wallabies pulled off a sensational 42-38 win over South Africa in Perth back in September. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
itvtynetees.uk.description: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Michael gets his chance to open the iconic red boxes. But in the game show with only one question, will Michael say Deal or No Deal when faced with The Banker's tempting offers, or will he instead choose to take home what's inside his box. (Game show) - 2026

itvtynetees.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Skye
itvtynetees.uk.description: James takes a magical trip to the stunning Isle of Skye, where he's joined by top chef and ultimate Scotsman Tony Singh. Tony visits a local bakery which doubles as an art gallery and learns to make the local oatcakes. James is inspired by the amazing local seafood and cooks up a tasty dish using plaice and lovage. Their day comes to a perfect end aboard a boat, where they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvtynetees.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Salem
itvtynetees.uk.description: James is in Salem on the East Coast of the USA. This town was made famous by the witch trials of 1692, and things get spooky as James is visiting on the approach to Hallo'ween! We hear from Salem's official witch Laurie Cabot. Meanwhile, James meets a love clairvoyant and her dogs! Salem isn't just about witchcraft, James visits a unique spice shop and picks up some spices to cook with. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvtynetees.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvtynetees.uk.description: The legendary Eric Idle joins Alan, and La Voix makes her Love Your Weekend debut. We catch up with our puppy school to see how the class of '26 is getting on, herb grower Jekka McVicar has potions and spells this Halloween weekend, and we are celebrating the joy of Monty Python in today's Best of British, in honour of Eric Idle. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Italy v South Africa
itvtynetees.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Italy face South Africa at the Allianz Stadium in Turin. Rassie Erasmus' side tops the southern hemisphere table after winning all three of their fixtures during the summer and the world champions will be looking to continue their perfect record in the competition. They take on an Italy side that is at the bottom of the northern hemisphere table after losing all three of their Nations Championship matches. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Scotland v New Zealand
itvtynetees.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Scotland face New Zealand at Murrayfield. Scotland have never beaten New Zealand, it's a run that goes back 121 years and stretches 33 matches. Last year, Gregor Townsend's side recovered from 17-0 down at half time to draw level with the All Blacks but a late try from Damian McKenzie helped maintain New Zealand's long unbeaten run against Scotland. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v Japan
itvtynetees.uk.description: Lauren Salter is joined by guests Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton for live rugby from round four of the Nations Championship as Wales host Japan at the Principality Stadium. Wales are looking to make a winning start against Eddie Jones' Japan side, who they beat by a single point in Cardiff a year ago. Every point will be crucial ahead of two tough fixtures against New Zealand and Australia, which will close out the Northern Series for Wales. (Rugby)

stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E5 Michael Stephen Mulhern hosts as Michael tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 Skye (30min) James is joined by fellow chef Tony Singh for a tour of the Isle of Skye and is inspired by the amazing local seafood to cook up a tasty dish using monkfish and mussels. The pair then take a boat trip, during which they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E17 Salem The chef explores Salem, Massachusetts, which was made famous by the witch trials of 1692. He visits a unique spice shop, where he picks up some ingredients to cook with, and also meets a seafood artist and makes a stop at Turner's, a family-run seafood business.

stvnorth.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
stvnorth.uk.description: S8 E28 Eric Idle and La Voix join Alan for a chat, while there is a catch-up with the puppy school to see how the class of '26 is getting on. Herb grower Jekka McVicar has potions and spells for Halloween, and today's Best of British celebrates the joy of Monty Python in honour of Eric.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News
stvnorth.uk.description: E85 07/11/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
stvnorth.uk.description: S9 E34 On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : Italy v South Africa
stvnorth.uk.description: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : Scotland v New Zealand
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E21 Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : Wales v Japan
stvnorth.uk.description: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E86 07/11/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : France v Fiji
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E23 France v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the match at Groupama Stadium in Lyon. This is the first game of the Northern Hemisphere series for both teams, and France narrowly lost to New Zealand in their first contest of the Southern Series, before recording victories over Australia and Japan. They will expect to continue their winning run against the Fijians, who have lost all three of their matches so far against Wales, England and Scotland. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Jamie Roberts, and commentary by Johnnie Hammond and Ben Kayser.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E88 07/11/2026 - 2 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
stvnorth.uk.description: S37 E2 Tom Allen presents another collection of outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring clips of Ant and Dec, Ralf Little, Jill Scott, Ricky Tomlinson, Prue Leith, Warwick Davis and many more, with the cock-ups including Bradley Walsh falling over during a recording of Blankety Blank.

stvnorth.uk.title: English Football League Highlights : 07/11/2026
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E17 Action from the latest matches, including Wrexham v Wolves at Molineux, Cardiff City v Burnley at Cardiff City Stadium and Watford v Middlesbrough at Vicarage Road in the Championship.

stvnorth.uk.title: Grantchester
stvnorth.uk.description: S9 E1 When the circus comes to town, Will and Geordie investigate after one of the performers is found dead having been shot with a crossbow that was used in a magic trick. After finding out the crossbow was tampered with and the death wasn't an accident, the pair have a difficult task in solving the crime as all the performers have alibis for the time of the murder and the circus was closed.

stvnorth.uk.title: Unwind with STV
stvnorth.uk.description: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

stvnorth.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E5 On her morning rounds, Liz takes a moment to appreciate the life the family have built on the farm, but their peaceful routine is interrupted when calf Elizabeth develops a worrying wheeze. Fearing pneumonia, the illness that claimed beloved Cherry last year, Kelvin and Liz call in vet Hugo to investigate. Meanwhile, with the pigs gone, the family begin transforming the old pig field into a vegetable patch.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E18 The Hamptons The chef's culinary journey takes him to New York resort the Hamptons. First, James learns about the area's rich farming history and visits Amber Waves Farm to cook a pizza using local, seasonal produce. Then, he pays a visit to seafood restaurant The Dock House in Sag Harbour, where he samples their famous chowder.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E19 Philadelphia James heads to Philadelphia, where Reading Terminal Market provides all manner of ingredients for his dishes. The market eve has its own kitchen, so if he forgets an ingredient, it is not a problem. James then takes a tour of the city's famous murals, sees one of the most impressive car collections in the world and hears about the rise of vegan eating restaurants in the city.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
stvnorth.uk.description: S9 E34 On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News
stvnorth.uk.description: E86 08/11/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
stvnorth.uk.description: S8 E29 Joining Alan at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are former racing driver Billy Monger and actress Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic.

stvnorth.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E6 Agronomist Ben Clare arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, while Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual date with a visit to local beekeepers. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end and Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home.

stvnorth.uk.title: Talking Royals
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 A weekly round-up of royal news, with expert analysis from ITV News' royal editor Chris Ship and expert Lizzie Robinson, and guests.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E5 Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Aikines-Aryeetey take on each other in a four-way cooking battle. They'll produce dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two celebrities who impress the most go through to the quarter finals, and the losing stars will have to impress world class chefs and cook again in the final few minutes, before one leaves the competition.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E82 08/11/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Flavour Foundations: Bahamian Classics Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Australia
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E24 England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Family At War - Into the Dark
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1971. Into The Dark. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Philip is brought into a desert hospital blinded. John considers suicide and Margaret makes her choice. (Drama, War & Politics, Entertainment) - 1970

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Young Mr. Pitt - 1942. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Carol Reed. Stars: Robert Donat, Robert Morley & Phyllis Calvert. This biopic tells the story of the 24-year-old British Prime Minister who served during the Napoleonic era. (Drama, Movie) - 2016

talkingpictures.uk.title: Public Eye - Nobody Wants to Know
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Nobody Wants to Know. Stars Alfred Burke, Ray Smith & Geoffrey Beevers. Marker has one week to find a witness. When he does so, he will never forget her. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join Caroline Munro as she gives an insight into tonight's film the 1953 horror The Four Sided Triangle, a brilliant Hammer Film directed by Terence Fisher. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Four Sided Triangle
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1953. Sci-fi Romance. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Barbara Payton, James Hayter & Stephen Murray. A man duplicates a woman who fell in love with his friend, so he may have a copy for himself. (Action, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 2012

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
talkingpictures.uk.description: Caroline Munro takes a look at the special film to be shown next week down in The Cellar Club. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Body Double
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1984. Thriller. Directed by Brian De Palma. Stars Craig Wasson & Melanie Griffith. A struggling actor's obsession with spying on a neighbour gets him caught up in a drastic series of events. (Crime, Mystery, Thriller, Movie) - 1984

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tomorrow
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1972. Drama. Directed by Joseph Anthony. Stars Robert Duvall, Olga Bellin & Sudie Bond. A lonely farmer takes in a pregnant drifter, but things take an unexpected turn after she gives birth. (Documentary, Movie) - 2015

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Most Dangerous Game - 1932. Horror. Directors
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ernest B. Schoedsack & Irving Pichel. Stars Fay Wray, Joel McCrea, Leslie Banks & Robert Armstrong. Shipwrecked on an island, a hunter becomes the guest of Count Zaroff. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2020

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cinebox Memories
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1963. Join English pop group The Mudlarks as they perform the charming hit song La De Da. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Vise - Ring of Greed
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1955. Stars Megs Jenkins, Clifford Evans & Betty Anne Davis. Margaret and Frank fell in love at first sight but will Margaret manage to escape from a fate that is unknown to her. (Crime, Drama, Entertainment) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Shoot a Crooked Arrow
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Art Carney & Doodles Weaver. Batman and Robin battle a latter-day Robin Hood who turns against the poor people of Gotham. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Walk the Straight and Narrow
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Art Carney & Loren Ewing. Batman and Robin escape their previous peril and are back in action seeking to foil the Archer's devious plans. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Minesweeper
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1943. War drama starring Richard Arlen, Jean Parker & Russell Hayden. A former naval deserter is drawn back to the services after the attack on Pearl Harbour. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance, War) - 1943

talkingpictures.uk.title: Talk About Jacqueline - 1942. Comedy. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past. (Reality, Movie)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Radio London 1967
talkingpictures.uk.description: A short promo film shot on board the Radio London pirate radio ship in summer 1967, shortly before the station's closure. DJ's seen include John Peel, Mark Roman, Pete Drummond and Willie Walker. (Documentary, Music, Entertainment) - 2010

talkingpictures.uk.title: Legend of the Hidden City
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Morgan plans to attack 'The Source'. Meanwhile, Ram declares war on Queen Kama and her people. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: William Tell - The Trap. 1959. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1998

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans - La Salle's Treasure
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Rodney Bunker. Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle. (Drama, Western, Entertainment) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lone Ranger - Rustler's Hideout
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger believes in Fred Vance and helps him settle during a war between the Madden gang and local ranches. (Action & Adventure, Western, Entertainment) - 1949

talkingpictures.uk.title: Supercar - Hostage
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. Stars George Murcell & David Graham. While in Ireland, Dr. Beaker overhears a plan by two smugglers to kidnap the daughter of an innkeeper and alerts his friends back at base. (Action & Adventure, Animation, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Food for Thought
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, John Sharplin & Patrick Troughton. A pair of villagers go to Robin's camp with news of an oppressive tax recently imposed by the greedy Count Olivier. (Action & Adventure, Family, Entertainment) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Biggles - 1986. Sci-Fi. Director Adventures in Time
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1986. Sci-Fi. Director: John Hough. Stars Peter Cushing, Neil Dickson, Alex Hyde-White. The daring flying ace takes on his arch rival aided by a British intelligence officer and a time traveller. (Movie) - 1960

talkingpictures.uk.title: H.M.S Defiant - 1962. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Alec Guinness, Dirk Bogarde & Maurice Denham. During the French Revolutionary War, Captain Crawford is stuck in a battle of with his second in command. (Movie)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scales of Justice
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1965. Personal and Confidential. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Ellen McIntosh. Police investigating a suspicious death find a file marked 'Top Secret' in the victim's briefcase. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1983

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Quatermass Xperiment - 1955. Horror. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Val Guest. Stars Brian Donlevy, Jack Warner & Thora Hird. A manned rocket ship returns to Earth with two astronauts missing and the survivor incapable of communicating. (Drama, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Movie) - 1979

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tell Me Another - Stories About How They Started in Showbusiness
talkingpictures.uk.description: How They Started in Showbusiness. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Yootha Joyce, Bernard Manning, Alfred Marks, Leslie Phillips, Terry Scott & Max Wall. (Entertainment) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Godmother
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Joan Sims. Glutton's Godmother, the Duchess of Durham comes to visit, and Sir John must convince her that he is married to become her heir. (Comedy, Drama, Entertainment) - 1979

talkingpictures.uk.title: Maigret
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Golden Fleece. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Francis De Wolff. Maigret investigates a strange accident, noticing that the men of the Paris canals do not take well to interference. (Crime, Drama, Mystery, Entertainment) - 2016

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lillie - The Jersey Lily
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Jennie Linden & Peter Egan. In London, Lillie becomes a 'Professional Beauty' and a social sensation. She also meets Oscar Wilde and Princess Louise. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Prudence and the Pill
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1968. Comedy. Directed by Fielder Cook. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Niven & Judy Geeson. Five couples get involved in comical chaos when they swap birth control pills to deceive each other. (Comedy, Romance, Movie) - 1968

talkingpictures.uk.title: EuroTrash
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we meet The Belgian Baldmen, get squashed in a squash court, then go back to nature in Germany and meet the German Pamela Anderson. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 1993

talkingpictures.uk.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
talkingpictures.uk.description: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties. (Entertainment) - 2001

talkingpictures.uk.title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Dandy Nichols. The adventures of an optimistic and inept window cleaner who finds other ways to satisfy his customers. (Comedy, Movie) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rentadick - 1972. Comedy. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jim Clark. Stars James Booth, Richard Briers & Julie Ege. The incompetent detectives of Rentadick Inc track thieves of a nerve gas that paralyses from the waist down. (Comedy, Movie) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Girl On The Pier - 1953. Crime. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lance Comfort. Stars Veronica Hurst, Ron Randell & Marjorie Rhodes. Rivalry between a Brighton crooner who has done time and his partner in crime, who is being blackmailed. (Crime, Documentary, Movie) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: One Step Beyond
talkingpictures.uk.description: Make Me Not a Witch. 1959. Stars Patty McCormack & Robert Emhardt. A girl's parents are terrified when their daughter reveals that she can read minds. But her gift may be able to save lives. (Drama, Mystery, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Enter the Lone Ranger
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1949. Western. Directed by Geroge B. Seitz Jr. Stars Clayton Moore & Jay Silverheels. The sole surviving Texas Ranger of a murderous ambush becomes the great masked hero who fights for justice. (Western, Movie) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. (Entertainment) - 2001

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Super Secret Service
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1953. Comedy. Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: Paratrooper - 1954. War. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Terence Young. Stars Leo Genn, Alan Ladd & Harry Andrews. Distraught over his role in a tragic training accident, a US Air Force officer secretly enlists in the British Army. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2019

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lest We Forget
talkingpictures.uk.description: An exclusive documentary commemorating the end of WWI. Presented by war historian Alan Forbes who visits the battlefields and memorials of Flanders and the Somme. (Entertainment) - 1935

talkingpictures.uk.title: We Will Remember Them
talkingpictures.uk.description: We join the nation in paying tribute to the fallen. We honour our heroes with The Last Post. (Documentary, Movie) - 2019

talkingpictures.uk.title: Carve Her Name With Pride - 1958. War Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Virginia McKenna, Paul Scofield & Jack Warner. Based on the true story of WW2 special agent Violette Szabo recruited to work as a spy in France. (Drama, War, Movie) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: Review No.1 29th Year (The Royal British Legion)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Take a look at what the Royal British Legion are doing to support their members and veterans of the British Armed Forces, also with a glimpse of the history of the charity. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Nine Men - 1943. War. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Harry Watt. Stars Gordon Jackson, Jack Lambert & Frederick Piper. British soldiers are attacked when travelling across the desolate wastes of WWII Libya. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Mystery, Movie) - 2016

talkingpictures.uk.title: That's My Boy - Hello Young Mothers
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Janet Davies & Jenny Tomasin. Ida discovers that there are plans to open a home for unmarried mothers and Mrs. Cross starts a petition against it. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 1981

talkingpictures.uk.title: For the Love of Ada - The Baby. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. As Ruth appears to be going into labour, Ada and Walter are troubled in their new home by the presence of a ghost. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 1970

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E - The Deadly Goddess Affair
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Michael Strong. Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal significant funds from THRUSH. (Action & Adventure, Comedy, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Footage Detectives
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home. (Entertainment) - 2021

together.uk.title: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
together.uk.description: The remaining hopefuls head to a local livestock auction to test how they would fit into the rural community. And back on the farm, the applicants work with Wallington's team of rangers, creating new wildlife habitats.

together.uk.title: The Good Karma Hospital

together.uk.title: Love Your Garden - The Drake Family
together.uk.description: Alan Titchmarsh presents the garden makeover show, transforming neglected spaces for some very special people. Alan and the team are in Dorset creating a garden for a young family coping with terminal illness. Student Rachel is 27 and met 29-year-old Dorset farm worker Andrew while out clubbing six years ago, and they became an item instantly. The couple were planning their future when Andrew was diagnosed with bowel cancer.

together.uk.title: Bang! You're Dead (1954)
together.uk.description: A tragic accident leads to man being wrongly accused of murder. (Mystery) - 1954

together.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
together.uk.description: Stacey Solomon and her gang - organizer Dilly, carpenter Rob and cleaner Iwan - challenge the Harris-Hawley family to sort their lives out in seven days. They ask the family to try to let go of half their possessions so that the team can then beautifully reorganise their home. Stacey gets to know the family behind the clutter - childhood sweethearts Dan and Char and their two daughters, Mia (11) and Cece (3) - who rent a two-up, two-down from their local council. (Home improvement, House/garden, Reality) - 2023

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Maremma
together.uk.description: As long as the water's warm, Clive loves to swim, so he's enthusiastic about taking a dip in the vast volcanic spring of Saturnia and discovering why Italians believe in the healing power of thermal water. Travelling on through Maremma - a big stretch of country running between Tuscany and Lazio - Clive stays in a treehouse at a lavender farm and learns how to extract oil from the plants.

together.uk.title: Flipping Profit - Buxton
together.uk.description: Antiques expert Caroline Hawley, trader Danny Sebastian and aeronautical engineer and upcycler Stu Abbott head to Buxton where they go head-to-head as they rummage through its antique shops, scrapyards and flea markets in the hope of finding any items that they can each turn into a healthy profit.

amc.us.title: The Rundown
amc.us.description: Beck (The Rock) is a tight-lipped bounty hunter who doesn't like to use a gun and accepts any job without asking questions. When Beck's employer, Walker (William Lucking), sends him to the Amazon to locate Walker's cocky son, Travis (Seann William Scott), Beck discovers a population controlled by a tyrannical treasure hunter (Christopher Walken). To survive, Beck and Travis must work together, without their affections for a mysterious rebel (Rosario Dawson) getting in the way. (Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2003

amc.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
amc.us.description: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. (Adventure, Fantasy, Action) - 2012

amc.us.title: Men in Black
amc.us.description: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Mystery) - 1997

amc.us.title: Men in Black II
amc.us.description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction) - 2002

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

amc.us.title: John Wick
amc.us.description: Legendary assassin John Wick (Keanu Reeves) retired from his violent career after marrying the love of his life. Her sudden death leaves John in deep mourning. When sadistic mobster Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen) and his thugs steal John's prized car and kill the puppy that was a last gift from his wife, John unleashes the remorseless killing machine within and seeks vengeance. Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2014

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
amc.us.description: Retired super-assassin John Wick's plans to resume a quiet civilian life are cut short when Italian gangster Santino D'Antonio shows up on his doorstep with a gold marker, compelling him to repay past favors. Ordered by Winston, kingpin of secret assassin society The Continental, to respect the organization's ancient code, Wick reluctantly accepts the assignment to travel to Rome to take out D'Antonio's sister, the ruthless capo atop the Italian Camorra crime syndicate. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: Unforgiven
amc.us.description: When prostitute Delilah Fitzgerald (Anna Thomson) is disfigured by a pair of cowboys in Big Whiskey, Wyoming, her fellow brothel workers post a reward for their murder, much to the displeasure of sheriff Little Bill Daggett (Gene Hackman), who doesn't allow vigilantism in his town. Two groups of gunfighters, one led by aging former bandit William Munny (Clint Eastwood), the other by the florid English Bob (Richard Harris), come to collect the reward, clashing with each other and the sheriff. (Western) - 1992

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
amc.us.description: When the dolphin mascot of Miami's NFL team is abducted, Ace Ventura, a zany private investigator who specializes in finding missing animals, looks into the case. Soon Miami Dolphins players are kidnapped too, including star player Dan Marino, making Ace's sleuth work even more pressing. Working with Dolphins representative Melissa Robinson, Ace closes in on the culprits, but not before many ridiculous misadventures. (Comedy) - 1994

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
amc.us.description: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

amc.us.title: We Are Marshall
amc.us.description: In 1970, Marshall University and the small town of Huntington, W.Va., reel when a plane crash claims the lives of 75 of the school's football players, staff members and boosters. New coach Jack Lengyel arrives on the scene in March 1971, determined to rebuild Marshall's Thundering Herd and heal a grieving community in the process. (Drama, Docudrama) - 2006

amc.us.title: The Replacements
amc.us.description: It's late in the season; the playoffs are fast approaching; and the Washington Sentinels have just gone on strike. Scrambling for a solution, the Sentinels' owner Edward O'Neil hatches a plan to bring in legendary coach Jimmy McGinty to recruit a team of replacement players in exactly one week. For fans and owners alike, the strike is a disaster. But for Shane Falco and a mismatched crew of outsiders, it is the second chance they've waited their whole lives for. (Comedy) - 2000

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - The Scorpion Queen
bravo.us.description: Tanner and Kate's flirtations become more obvious to the crew; Rhylee continues to feel ostracized by the deck crew that tried to get her fired; after a short-lived reconciliation, Brian and Courtney are on the outs again. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2020-01-20

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - Let Them Eat Penis Cake!
bravo.us.description: Capt. Lee calls a staff meeting to address the previous night's debauchery; Brian refuses to apologize for his behavior; Kate's patience is tested by sports journalist Jemele Hill; Kevin and Kate butt heads over their final beach picnic. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2020-01-27

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - Big Girls, Do Cry
bravo.us.description: Kate sets Kevin up for failure by allowing him to present an erotic cake; Capt. Lee arranges a party on a private beach for the crew's final night; Courtney and Brian try to resolve their issues; Tanner tries to woo Kate; Kevin confronts Kate. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2020-02-03

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - What a Thai to Be Alive
bravo.us.description: Fraser Olender tours the yacht, meets the newest crew members and shares his hopes for Rainbeau de Roos' return in Thailand. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2026-10-12

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - Pier Pressure
bravo.us.description: A new crew faces power struggles and setbacks before the first charter. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2026-10-13

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - Mo Preferences, Moe Problems
bravo.us.description: Demanding guests with lengthy preference sheets cause problems for Chef Moe and the interior. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2026-10-26

bravo.us.title: Below Deck - Diva Down Bad for a Deckie
bravo.us.description: A missing jet ski strap and forgotten towels make for a chaotic start to the day, leaving Capt. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2026-11-02

bravo.us.title: Beetlejuice
bravo.us.description: After Barbara and Adam Maitland die in a car accident, they find themselves stuck haunting their country residence, unable to leave the house. When the unbearable Deetzes and teen daughter Lydia buy the home, the Maitlands attempt to scare them away without success. Their efforts attract Beetlejuice, a rambunctious spirit whose help quickly becomes dangerous for the Maitlands and innocent Lydia. (Comedy, Fantasy) - 1988

bravo.us.title: Beetlejuice
bravo.us.description: A couple returns from the dead to find that they are back in their beloved home, as ghosts. They are horrified when the house is sold to a pretentious couple. - 1988

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm
bravo.us.description: Following several Charleston singles as they pursue their personal and professional lives; trying to preserve their family names because just one social faux pas can taint a family's name for generations.

bravo.us.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City - Hip Hop and Heartbreak
bravo.us.description: Meredith and Seth are happy to be back together; Jen plans a surprise birthday party for her husband and doesn't invite Mary; Whitney hears that the other women are talking about Jen behind her back.

bravo.us.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City - In Hot Water
bravo.us.description: Jen's relationships are on the rocks after her blow-up at Sharrieff's birthday party; Lisa focuses on work; Meredith and Seth share some good news; Whitney and Heather try to make amends with Jen.

bravo.us.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City - All Bets Are Off
bravo.us.description: Whitney hosts a dinner with her dad and siblings in an effort to reunite their family; Jen sets Heather up with Sharrieff's best friend; Jen begins to question Heather's true loyalty.

bravo.us.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City - Sinners in the City
bravo.us.description: The Vegas trip implodes during dinner when Jen feels betrayed by Meredith and Lisa; the ladies gather together to discover there is more deception brewing amongst the group; Mary reminds Lisa of Jen's destructive behavior.

bravo.us.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City - Chilly Reception
bravo.us.description: At the Beauty Lab launch party, Jen tries to make amends with friends, but it doesn't go as planned; Heather worries that she hasn't connected with Jen since Vegas; Meredith and Seth realize that their marriage is a hot topic for their friends.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Vows, Vendettas and Vibrators
bravo.us.description: The Charmers celebrate Madison's marriage to her Prince Charming, but everyone isn't in a festive mood; Austen comes face-to-face with multiple exes; Craig gets caught in the crossfire of an icy reunion between Shep and Taylor.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Spilling the JT
bravo.us.description: The spotlight is on the aftermath of accusations spilled at Madison's wedding party, but attention quickly turns when newcomer JT vocalizes his suspicions about Austen and Taylor to Shep.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - He Said, She Said
bravo.us.description: The girls decide Taylor needs a good old-fashioned Southern soirée, swapping tales and spillin' tea; Shep kills the fun, however, when he delivers a scandalous rumor to Olivia's front door.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - In Vino Veritas
bravo.us.description: After Olivia hears what went down between Austen and Taylor, she's unsure how to move forward; Taylor brings the group together for her first big work event and more rumors bubble to the surface; Shep wastes no time confronting Austen.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Party Fowl
bravo.us.description: Shep attempts to put the group's messiness aside and host a proper Southern dinner for his closest friends; when Olivia learns the truth from Taylor about what really happened with Austen, emotions boil over and Austen gets skewered.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Family Bonds
bravo.us.description: The drama comes to a halt when a tragedy affects the Charmer's close circle, and they rally to support Olivia.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - The Naked Truth
bravo.us.description: Shep and Taylor try to move forward as friends, while Olivia and Rod's romance continues to blossom; when JT hosts an intimate dinner party, Southern etiquette is stripped away after Madison exposes Taylor's secret.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Bra-gate
bravo.us.description: Shep decides the guys need a break from the chaos of Charleston, S.C., so they escape to his family home in the North Carolina mountains; when Rod finds out about a secret rendezvous between Olivia and Austen, all bets are off for a tranquil getaway.

bravo.us.title: Southern Charm - Strange Bedfellows
bravo.us.description: The guys' weekend of fishing and debauchery is interrupted when Olivia and Taylor crash their mountain getaway; tensions flare and Shep erupts after a game of ping pong goes terribly wrong.

bravo.us.description: A one-handed salesman, an Amish farm boy and a pretty con artist pull bowling scams to get to a $1 million tournament in Reno. - 1996

bravo.us.title: The Longest Yard
bravo.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them. (Comedy) - 2005

Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). bravo.us.title: Strays
bravo.us.description: Abandoned on the mean city streets by his lowlife owner, Doug, a naive but lovable dog named Reggie falls in with a fast-talking, foul-mouthed Boston Terrier and his gang of strays. Determined to seek revenge, Reggie and his new canine pals embark on an epic adventure to get him home and make Doug pay for his dirty deed. (Comedy) - 2023
