cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemax.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemax.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: Harley Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask and every other thug in Gotham. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: A detective (Chazz Palminteri) questions a con man about his relationships with assorted criminals (Stephen Baldwin, Gabriel Byrne) and their link to a ship explosion. - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemax.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting. - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform at the Talk of the Town nightclub in 1968. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: An overachieving, blind athlete (Adam Scott) and his slacker sibling (Nick Kroll) compete for the affection of the same woman (Jenny Slate). - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch. - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland. - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. - 2000

cinemax.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemax.us.description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. (Musical, Biography, Historical drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2013-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2005-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2011-12-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2018-05-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-03-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take

Picking up where they left off, the buddies -- with wives and children in tow -- discover why age does not, necessarily, equal maturity. (Comedy) - 2010

comedycentral.us.title: Grown Ups 2
comedycentral.us.description: Lenny Feder moves his family back to his hometown to be with his friends, but he finds -- what with old bullies, new bullies, party crashers and more -- that he hasn't left the crazy life behind in Los Angeles. Lenny's friends must also cope with their own challenges: Eric must face his ultimate fear; Kurt has gone back to work as a cable repairman; and Marcus learns that he has an 18-year-old son. (Comedy) - 2013

foodnetwork.us.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking - Premières fois mémorables
foodnetwork.us.description: James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain. (Cooking) - 2026-11-04

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Ocean Coasts and Great Lakes
foodnetwork.us.description: In Los Angeles, a Mexican joint in Grand Central Market serves outrageous octopus tostadas and their spin on a burger; in Norfolk, a bistro turns out grown-up, gourmet grilled cheese; a righteous stop in Lansing does it up right. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2017-09-15

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Delicious Discoveries
foodnetwork.us.description: This trip, Guy Fieri uncovers some surprising culinary discoveries; in Columbus, Ohio, a hidden gem tucked away in a grocery store serves out-of-bounds Nepalese-Tibetan specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2018-01-19

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meaty Mashup
foodnetwork.us.description: In Little Rock, Ark., a gas station-turned-eatery pumps bison into a burrito and piles pork onto cornmeal waffles; in Santa Rosa, Calif., a Vietnamese joint makes pho and barbecue pork; in Sonoma, Calif., a barbecue spot loads up a monster burger. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2018-11-09

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Round the World Roundup
foodnetwork.us.description: In Smyrna, Ga., a doctor-turned-chef fires up amazing Asian from righteous ramen to Korean wings. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2019-02-08

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - British, Hawaiian and Mexican
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy grabs grub from all around the globe; in Wilmington, Del., there's a true British pub serving authentic English staples from fish and chips to Yorkshire Pudding; a poke counter is dishing out a Hawaiian classic with an updated twist in Kauai. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2019-06-14

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Spinning the Globe
foodnetwork.us.description: In Kauai, Hawaii, a culinary dojo amping up local specialties like saimin and chili pepper chicken; a twist on tacos and burritos in Kansas City, Mo.; a funky food truck in El Paso, Texas, putting out meatless Mexican that's huge on taste. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2019-08-02

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Smokin' Hot BBQ
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's diving into all kinds of 'cue on this trip; in Ottawa, Canada, a funky chicken joint cranking the rotisserie; in Burlington, Vt., a place smokin' their wings; Texas-style spot in Richmond, Va. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2020-01-31

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Pierogis, Pork and Pizza
foodnetwork.us.description: A sandwich shop serving up tastes of Peru in Hollywood, Fla.; a pierogi palace in Philadelphia giving a fresh take on Polish specialties; a wood-fired pizza spot putting its own spin on pies in Fargo, N.D. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2020-11-20

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Chicken to Cheesesteak
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is digging into chicken and some crazy creations; in Palm Springs, Calif., a crêpe spot is all about the savory, while a joint is cooking real deal Mexican pollo; an Egyptian food truck is serving wings and a falafel waffle. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2022-08-26

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Chicken, Steak and Cake
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's doubling up with sweet and savory, both hot and cold; there are chicken and steak arepas in San Juan, Puerto Rico, winning wings from a food truck in Laramie, Wyo., and an ice cream-cake combo; a raclette-ramen mashup in Cleveland. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2022-05-20

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Stuffed, Smoked and Wrapped
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is pickin' up what Flavortown is puttin' down, starting at a Nashville joint that's adding green chile crunch to their signature wrap; in Florida, two beach spots are smokin' up alligator ribs and serving Venezuelan stuffed specialties. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2022-09-16

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Interesting Italian
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is digging into all kinds of Italian; in Santa Barbara, Calif., Dennis Miller's riding shotgun for prime pizza; in Las Vegas, a vegan joint puts its spin on an Italian sandwich; a funky pizzeria stuffs chicken parm into stromboli. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2023-01-27

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Meaty to Meatless
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's digging into dishes with and without meat; in Mobile, AL, there's rabbit, while in Omaha, NE, a vegan joint brings a meatless spin to fried chicken; in Stamford, CT, Guy and sportscaster Dan Patrick chow down on Greek. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2023-11-10

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Coast-to-Coast Comfort
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri digs Greek-style lasagna at a family-run diner in Columbus; a California joint adds flair to comfort food with top-notch chicken and dumplings; big deal BBQ in New Jersey serves up pork and brisket piled high. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2024-09-20

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sauerkraut, Shoyu and Shank
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's grabbing creative flavor combos that pack a punch; a NYC couple is bringing Greek grub to Naples, FL; a Dallas spot is serving over-the-top pork belly lollipops; a Triple-G winner is putting out next-level ramen in Chicago. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2025-03-07

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Buns, Burgers and Bolognese
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's digging into pork dumplings from a husband-and-wife team in Sacramento, Calif.; a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla. Bistro is mixing up a meat sauce; a mom-and-pop shop in San Jose, Calif. Serves up black bean burgers. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2026-04-10

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Sandwiches, Seafood & Soba Noodles ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's digging into fresh fish, sammies!; in Seattle, a seafood spot is dishing out a rockfish banh mi, and a Japanese joint is serving up soba and decadent duck; plus, there's real-deal BBQ in Tampa, bringing big flavor to the-bomb brisket.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Beef, Chicken, and Pork
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri digs into top meats, from righteous Tampa farm-to-sandwich roast pork to lights-out pastaria lasagna in Bentonville, Ark.; he aslo tries legit family-made noodle bowls in Rogers, Ark.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Dirty, Crunchy, Sticky and Veggie
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is diving into texture and flavor; a BBQ bistro in Sherman Oaks is cooking the brisket noodles; a Cincinnati diner is plating top-notch chili crunch chicken nuggets; a spot in Austin is serving up a primo pasta margarita.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Flavortown Finds
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's finding flavor, starting with a Gainesville, Fla., bagel shop serving carrot-style lox on salted rosemary; then a Baton Rouge, La., joint is chargrilling oysters, and a spot in Naples, Fla., is serving prime-time pastrami.

Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

mgmplus.us.title: Invasion U.S.A.
mgmplus.us.description: Retired CIA agent Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris) is forced back into the business when a villain from his past re-emerges. Soviet Mikhail Rostov (Richard Lynch), a terrorist whom Matt once caught, wants to exact revenge. After failing to find Matt at his Everglades home, Rostov and his army of Communist guerrillas begin carrying out terrorist acts all over southern Florida. Millions of innocent lives are at risk, and it's up to Matt, the National Guard and the FBI to save them. (Action) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: Biker Boyz
mgmplus.us.description: Slick Will, the mechanic for a legendary motorcycle racer named Smoke (Laurence Fishburne), is struck dead during an off-the-grid race. Following the funeral, and in opposition to his mother's protests, Slick Will's son, Kid (Derek Luke), starts racing in the same fringe circuit -- but, despite Kid's skill and showmanship, Smoke refuses to race him. Spurned by the man he looked up to, Kid starts a rival motorcycle gang called the Biker Boyz, and a showdown between them is inevitable. (Action, Drama, Crime drama) - 2003

mgmplus.us.title: Hoodlum
mgmplus.us.description: Having just been released from jail, Bumpy Johnson (Laurence Fishburne) returns to his criminal ways as a linchpin in the African-American-run numbers racket. However, Bumpy's longtime friend Illinois Gordon (Chi McBride) and girlfriend Francine Hughes (Vanessa Williams) are both eager to get him back on the straight and narrow. But a brewing rivalry with Mafia boss Lucky Luciano (Andy Garcia) and his henchman Dutch Schultz (Tim Roth) threatens to raise the stakes to dangerous new levels. (Crime drama) - 1997

mgmplus.us.title: Death Wish
mgmplus.us.description: Dr. Paul Kersey is a surgeon who often sees the consequences of the city's violence in the emergency room. When home intruders brutally attack his wife and young daughter, Kersey becomes obsessed with delivering vigilante justice to the perpetrators. As the anonymous slayings grab the media's attention, the public begins to wonder if the deadly avenger is a guardian angel -- or the Grim Reaper itself. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2018

The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2001

mgmplus.us.title: Rounders
mgmplus.us.description: Mike McDermott loses his money in a poker game against Russian gangster Teddy "KGB". Under pressure from his girlfriend, Jo, he promises to quit gambling. This lasts until his friend, Lester "Worm" Murphy, gets out of prison and needs to pay off an old debt. The pair come close to earning the money back but are caught cheating. Then Mike finds out the debt is owed to Teddy and makes one last-ditch effort to beat the Russian. (Drama) - 1998

mgmplus.us.title: Red Eye
mgmplus.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

mgmplus.us.title: A Working Man

mgmplus.us.title: Out of Time

He begins a passionate affair with Ann (Sanaa Lathan), only to find out that she's stricken with terminal cancer. Matt steals a large sum of money confiscated from a drug bust in order to pay for Ann's treatment -- but when she apparently dies in a suspicious fire, the money disappears, and all the clues point to Matt as the culprit. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2003

Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. (Comedy) - 1998

mgmplushits.us.title: Beauty Shop

Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down. (Comedy) - 2005

mgmplushits.us.title: Uptown Girls

But everything changes when Molly realizes that her manager has stolen her money. She lands a job as a nanny for Ray (Dakota Fanning), a young girl whose serious attitude is the opposite of Molly's carefree one. With help from her boyfriend, Neal (Jesse Spencer), Molly tries to bond with Ray and learn how to be an adult. (Comedy) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Baby Boom

She moves to Vermont and embarks on a series of life-changing events. But when offered the opportunity, will she return to her corporate ways? (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1987

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Mopar Muscle Truck Gets a Hemi!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Wagoneer Road Trip!

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Another One Bites: The Duster!
motortrend.us.description: The guys add a '71 Rally Red Duster to the fleet; unfortunately, it hasn't moved since '93, but that's not as unfortunate as its slant-six power plant; the guys get the Plymouth back on the road, but it's not long before the engine reveals its worth.

motortrend.us.description: Big Blower? Check. Anything else Pro Street?

motortrend.us.title: Hot Rod Garage - The Crown Hick Gets Supercharged V-8 Power!

motortrend.us.description: The work continues at Willie's shop as more families' lives are changed by receiving a car for Christmas; Kevin Byrd joins Willie for the builds, bringing his expertise and passion to the cause.

motortrend.us.description: Willie B and a dedicated team of friends come together to revive a group of donated vehicles for his annual Cars for Christmas charity event, helping provide reliable transportation to families in need.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 63 Lincoln Convertible
motortrend.us.description: The owner of a 1963 Lincoln Continental convertible realizes that he's in way over his head when it comes to maintaining the classic vehicle.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 65 Impala
motortrend.us.description: The new owner of a 1965 Chevy Impala scraps plans to restore the vehicle to its former glory due to a shortage of time and money.

motortrend.us.description: We finish the Rimrocker Trail and roll into Moab, Utah; but the adventure is just getting started as we tackle the obstacles of Behind the Rocks, then cap it all off with one of the most breathtaking trails in the country, Top of the World.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 64 GTO
motortrend.us.description: A family restores a GTO to honor their late father; a 1964 Pontiac GTO means the world to this family, having belonged to their late devoted husband and father.

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - Shattered Dodge Revival

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - Trading Down and Giving Back!
motortrend.us.description: Influencers taking on Eric Malone from "Fastest Cars in the Dirty South" in grudge races; Freiburger and Finnegan head in reverse by trading a clean duster for a worse car.

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill - The Rubber Duck Firebird's Ultimate Drag Test!

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Inside Sydney Airport - White Powder Christmas ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The busy Christmas season picks up, with thousands of families going on holiday, but the airport is shut down when an unidentified white powder is discovered onboard an incoming flight. (Documentary, Adventure) - 2023-08-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley helps an alpaca with an eye injury, a horse with a colic emergency and a dangerously emaciated dog. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2021-04-24

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Africa is an extraordinary continent, shaping the wildlife that call it HOME. (Documentary) - 2026-09-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Welcome to Africa. We take you deep into the heart of our wildest continent, bringing you closer to its animals, landscapes and the people watching over it than ever before. (Documentary) - 2026-09-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Dust ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa's longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert. (Special, Documentary) - 2026-09-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Mysterious Islands - Island of the Greek Goddess ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Explorations into the ruins of a previously unknown civilization, a strange green light in the jungle, a long-lost temple, and a Red Sea trade centre. (Documentary, Travel) - 2024-05-06

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Absolute Destruction ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Thord and Bjorn face the ultimate rescue challenge when a truck is destroyed after crashing 40 metres down a mountainside. (Reality, Travel, Nature, Outdoors) - 2022-10-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Alaska's Grizzly Gauntlet - Kodiak Kings ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Survivalist Les Stroud gets up close and personal with the biggest brown bears of them all as they race to ready themselves for their long hibernation. (Reality, Nature, Animals) - 2018-04-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - The Last Bite ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: As snake season closes, Mbali's training shifts up a gear. (Reality, Animals, Documentary)

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Talk Turkey to Me ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: This Thanksgiving the birds are calling the shots at Pol Veterinary Services when Charles adopts three turkeys that are on the run. Then, when Gail and Lynn Wernette find a pair of wandering great Danes near their home, they bring them to the clinic.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - No Moosetakes ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley operates on an unusual mass and investigates a musk ox with a hair loss problem.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans - Stepping Stones ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The younger generation of Alaska Natives step up to new challenges.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Equator's Wild Secrets - Coral Kingdom ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Coral reefs of the Asia-Pacific region are the richest on planet Earth. For the weird and wonderful creatures of the oceans rainforests, interdependence is key to survival.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Equator's Wild Secrets - Secret Creatures of The Andes ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Intersecting the equator, the Ecuadorian Andes are a biodiversity hotspot where jungle dwellers live alongside alpine specialists, all uniquely adapted to survive the extremes of mountain-living.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Equator's Wild Secrets - Amazon: The Great Flood ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Every year the world's largest rainforest undergoes an epic transformation. Who survives Amazonia's shift from the dry to the wet and who doesn't?

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Mooovin' on Up ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr Pol and team rush to get their patients healed before the Isabella County Fair.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - One Pol Over the Cuckoo's Nest ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The vets of Pol Veterinary Services deal with ornery ungulates, cut colts, knobby knees and more.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home - Welcome to Africa ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Africa is an extraordinary continent, shaping the wildlife that call it HOME.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home - Jungle ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Welcome to Africa. We take you deep into the heart of our wildest continent, bringing you closer to its animals, landscapes and the people watching over it than ever before.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Into The Night ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Daylight hours are short on Norway's most treacherous roads, where the darkness makes the tow truck rescuers' jobs all the more dangerous.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Fishy Business ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A truck loaded with fresh fish blocks a main traffic artery in northern Norway, and it is up to Jo Roger to get it free. Not only is there a risk of huge traffic jams forming, but 300,000 euros are at stake should the cargo not reach its recipient.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - In the Family
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Being an ice road tow trucker, you have to work around the clock. The only way to make time for family life is to make the workplace like home, and a place for both family and friends.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - River Deep ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the far North of Norway, a brigade of road rescuers fight every day to keep the roads open and safe in winter. Damage control is a key factor. If they destroy anything during a rescue, they will have to pay the cost.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Jaguar vs. Croc ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Bertie travels to Canada to film a familiar pack of wolves hunting moose.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wild Life: The Big Freeze ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Filmmaker Bertie Gregory braves the Canadian Arctic to encounter a unique group of animals who have learned to thrive in the conditions.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close With Bertie Gregory ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In Mexico's Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean's most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant here, hammerhead numbers have declined enough that encounters are now rare.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wild Hunters - Reptiles ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Despite their ancient appearance, reptiles are creatures full of surprises and sophistication. Much like dinosaurs, reptiles are hugely efficient hunters.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Shark Attack Files - Growing Pains ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: After a diver is attacked during a routine move of a sand tiger shark in an aquarium, scientists are baffled by the shark's unusual behaviour. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-07-20

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Shark Attack Files - Get Smart ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: After a spearfisherman is mauled by a shark, researchers begin to wonder if animals in the wild can offer clues as to how to outsmart these perfect predators. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-07-19

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Africa's Deadliest - Desert Killers ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the oppressive heat of the African dunes and deserts, only the strong survive. A look at the exceptional animals that use brains and brawn to thrive in this unforgiving environment. (Animals, Documentary) - 2022-10-19

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Africa's Deadliest - Deadly Waters ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The fearsome and powerful Nile crocodiles await the violent fights between hippos. The waterholes of Africa are the stage for one of the continent's greatest spectacles. (Animals, Documentary) - 2022-11-04

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Reindeer Pains ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr Oakley visits with an angry cat that may have diabetes and a dog with a gland problem. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2014-05-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Schroeders reel in an unexpected catch during a family boating trip. (Reality, Animals) - 2023-10-07

nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The docs save a cat that can't pee and rescue a St. Bernard's dying tongue. (Reality, Animals) - 2023-10-14

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Oh, Pol-y Night ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Ho, oh, no. It's Christmas season in Michigan and Dr Pol and his team make their patient list, check it twice, and treat those who are naughty, spotty, snotty and nice. (Reality, Animals) - 2017-01-07

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Wizard of Paws ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: It's a dog's world at Pol Clinic, and the vets have their paws full of a crew of pups. (Reality, Animals) - 2017-02-11

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Safari Showdown ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Whether it's a prowling lion breaking into a tent or an angry elephant charging a truck, we see what happens when wildlife offers safari visitors an adventure they aren't prepared for. (Documentary, Nature) - 2025-09-10

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Space Invaders ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: From bears taking a dip in a hot tub to raccoons raiding kitchens or alligators at the front door, we witness what happens when wild animals, fed up with us invading their space, decide to invade ours. (Documentary) - 2025-09-11

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: From thirsty koalas and boxing kangaroos to parrots that surf on cars and bad-tempered wombats, we discover the most unusual and unruly behaviours of fauna from Australia and New Zealand. (Documentary) - 2025-09-24

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob's singing means no more Krabby Patties in 'Banned In Bikini Bottom'. Then in 'Stanley S. SquarePants', SpongeBob's cousin comes to visit, and quickly turns his life upside down.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob appears on TV for one second at 3 o'clock in the morning and becomes a major star in 'As Seen On TV', and then in 'Can You Spare A Dime?', Squidward quits his job.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick learn a really bad word, and start using it everywhere (yipes!) in 'Sailor Mouth', and then in 'Artist Unknown', Squidward tries to teach SpongeBob about art. (S2, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mrs Puff will do anything to make sure that SpongeBob passes his driving test in 'No Free Rides', and in 'I'm Your Biggest Fanatic', SpongeBob finds out his hero isn't so great. (S2, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob throws away Mr Krabs' old mattress - the one that he kept all his money in - in 'The Lost Mattress', and then in 'Krabs vs. Plankton', Plankton slips and sues The Krusty Krab for damages.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton turns everyone into babies in 'Goo Goo Gas', and then in 'Le Big Switch', SpongeBob switches places with a snooty French chef at a high-end restaurant.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: It's King Neptune's birthday, and SpongeBob wants to make sure his friends and family are there, including his son, Triton. But Neptune and Triton don't get along...

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp. (S2, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Camp Master Krabs hires the Flying Dutchman to run the camp store in 'Boo Light Special', then in 'Lake Crashers', The campers have a demolition derby under Lake Yuckymuck. (S1, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: When Squidward is hurt on the job, he threatens to sue Mr. Krabs in 'Accidents Will Happen', and in 'The Other Patty', Mr. Krabs and Plankton find a common enemy in the new 'Flabby Patty' restaurant.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob finds a nasty sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab in 'Eek, An Urchin!', and then in 'Squid's Defense', Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor in 'The Getaway', then in 'Lost and Found', when Mr. Krabs sends him searching for a missing toy, SpongeBob finds himself lost too!

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day in 'A Finful of Sand Dollars', then in 'Cretins of the Night', SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night. (S2, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: Beneath the Bun: Krabby Patty ...
nicktoons.uk.description: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob finds a cute but inconvenient companion in 'Lighthouse Louie', then in 'Hiccup Plague', no one in Bikini Bottom is safe from a case of contagious hiccups.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Loose Patrick's uncontrollable drooling gets out of hand and mouth in 'The Drooling Fool', then in 'Patrick's Got A Zoo', A shape-shifting alien runs loose in the Star home. (S1, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The show finds an adorable new star in 'Patty-Poo', then in 'Swaptoberfest', the Star family swap identities. (S3, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: End of Summer Daze: As everyone packs up and leaves Kamp Koral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay to catch jellyfish. But two criminals arrive to use the emptied camp as their criminal hideaway! (S2, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The monsters of camp host a support group in 'Calling Some Monsters', then in 'Dig This', a buried bone unearths a heap of trouble for Sandy. (S2, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton learns self-defense from Sandy in 'Single-Celled Defense', then in 'Buff for Puff', Mr. Krabs steps out of his shell and into the gym after Larry shows him up at the beach. (S14, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick hires cheap ghosts to haunt his house, but gets what he paid for in 'The Haunting of Star House', then in 'Who's a Big Boy?', Patrick hits a growth spurt in his late adolescence. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bunny must punish Patrick for chocolate-flavoured crimes in 'At Home, On the Lam', then in 'Pick Patrick's Path', the Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next. (S2, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: It's SpongeBob's turn to be 'Hall Monitor' at Boating School, and in 'Jellyfish Jam' SpongeBob takes a wild jellyfish home but it multiplies and the jellyfish begin to take over! (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge. (S5, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob must write an essay before the next morning, but gets distracted in 'Procrastination', and then in 'I'm With Stupid', SpongeBob acts stupid to make Patrick look smarter. (S2, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs wisely chooses SpongeBob and Patrick to decorate his living room in 'Wet Painters', and then in 'Krusty Krab Training Video', we learn about being an excellent employee.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Narlene and Nobby teach Regigilled about backwoods living in 'Regi-Hilled', then in 'The Perfect Camper', the Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games. (S1, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral in 'Help Not Wanted', then in 'Camp Spirit', SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob moves into the Krusty Krab (so that he'll never be late again) in 'New Digs', and then in 'Krabs A La Mode', Plankton has an idea to cause some chilly trouble for Mr Krabs.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick must replace Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy in a 'Shuffleboarding' tournament, and then in 'Professor Squidward', Squidward is mistaken for his much more famous rival.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Cecil's boss visits the house in 'Sitcom Stars', then in 'The Show Must Go Yawn', Squidina is bedridden, and Patrick has to run his show without her. (S4, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Tinkle, Ouchie, and Pinkeye must venture back home together in 'The Uncredible Journey', then in 'Host-a-Palooza', Patrick gets injured, so his family members take turns hosting the show. (S1, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: A statue of Mr. Krabs is erected by Squidward in 'The Masterpiece', and then in 'Whelk Attack', Bikini Bottom gets invaded by large sea whelks.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob is forced to go back to the milkshake academy in 'License to Milkshake', and then in 'Squid Baby', SpongeBob and Patrick must look after Squidward after he hits his head.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The weekly food delivery truck goes missing in 'Quest for Tire', and in 'A Cabin of Curiosities', a mysterious cabin of odd campers have frightful fun with SpongeBob and Patrick after dark. (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot in 'Mascot Mayhem', then in 'Putt Up or Shut Up', Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game. (S2, ep 9)

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Jeffy T's Prankwell Emporium; A Taste of Plankton

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Kenny the Cat; Yeti Krabs

(Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2011-06-04

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Cuddle E. Hugs; Pat the Horse

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Rise and Shine & Waiting; Fungus Among Us

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Chaperone; Employee of the Month

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Pablum Plankton; MuseBob ModelPants

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Wary Gary; Pinned

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Driven to Tears; Rule of Dumb

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Pineapple Fever; Chum Caverns

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Wormy; Patty Hype

nicktoons.us.description: Plankton tries to befriend Squidward so he can get the Krabby Patty formula; the citizens of Bikini Bottom clamor for Patrick's artwork after an art critic praises him. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2011-07-20

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Chatterbox Gary; Don't Feed the Clowns
nicktoons.us.description: Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm; when a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes the hapless harlequin under his wing. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2018-01-15

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Krusty Towers; Mrs. Puff, You're Fired
nicktoons.us.description: Mr. Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a hotel; SpongeBob's record of failed boating tests causes Mrs. Puff to lose her job. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2006-04-01

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - A Cabin in the Kelp; The Hankering
nicktoons.us.description: The Gal Pals take Pearl to a cabin in the woods for a weekend of silly pranks; Mr. Krabs has a secret taste for something surprising. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2019-11-30

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Clash of Triton

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Squidness Protection; Dome Alone
nicktoons.us.description: Squidward's new life is threatened; stuck in her dome, Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good and gets Patrick to investigate.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - SquarePants Family Vacation

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Smartificial Intelligence; Firehouse Bob
nicktoons.us.description: Perch Perkins fights for his job after he's fired and replaced by a robot anchorman; SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward feel the heat when they become volunteer firefighters.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Drive Happy; Old Man Patrick

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Friend or Foe

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Culture Shock; F.U.N.

nicktoons.us.description: While in prison, Plankton teams up with his fellow inmates to break out of jail and steal the secret Krabby Patty formula; SpongeBob replaces his broken spatula with one from Plankton.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - The Nasty Patty; The Idiot Box
nicktoons.us.description: Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob hide the health inspector's body; SpongeBob and Patrick throw out their new TV and keep the box.

nicktoons.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Eek, an Urchin!; Squid's Defense
nicktoons.us.description: SpongeBob finds a sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab; Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate.

screenpix.us.title: Romeo and Juliet
screenpix.us.description: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger. (Romance) - 1954

screenpix.us.title: Electra
screenpix.us.description: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestis (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide? (Drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: Moulin Rouge
screenpix.us.description: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme. (Biography) - 1952

screenpix.us.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
screenpix.us.description: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.description: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction. (Science fiction) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: Foreign Intrigue
screenpix.us.description: After the sudden death of his millionaire boss, Dave Bishop (Robert Mitchum) begins a quest to discover the source of his mysterious employer's wealth. On a journey that will take Bishop across the European continent, life-threatening encounters lurk around every corner. As Bishop soon finds out, his boss acquired his wealth through underhanded schemes and blackmail. Now that their blackmailer is dead, those who are free want to keep Bishop from taking his place. (Drama) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: The Fearmakers
screenpix.us.description: After two years as a Korean War POW, Alan Eaton (Dana Andrews) returns home, where the Washington, D.C., PR firm he co-founded was sold to Jim McGinnis (Dick Foran) just before Alan's partner died in a car accident. Invited to stay as a consultant, Alan grows suspicious when his friend Sen. Walder (Roy Gordon) tells him he suspects the company has become a propaganda outlet. Fearing his partner may have been murdered, Alan discovers McGinnis is behind an anti-nuclear-power communist plot. (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.description: In California, a group of women struggles with personal problems as their paths intertwine in unexpected ways. Dr. Elaine Keener, the sole caretaker for her aging mother, turns to tarot card reader Christine for spiritual aid. Christine grapples with her own angst due to her lover's debilitating illness. Meanwhile, a bank manager deals with an unwanted pregnancy, two sisters pursue romantic interests and a housewife gets back into the dating game. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2000

After a heavy beating, the cyclists abandon Darryl but take Chris with them to Mexico. While Chris faces threats of abuse, Darryl teams up with Smiley (Jock Mahoney), an aging ex-Stomper, for a final showdown with the Souls. (Action) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: The Savage Seven
screenpixaction.us.description: A motorcycle gang terrorizes a Native American reservation -- until the gang's leader, Kisum (Adam Roarke), falls for waitress Marcia Little Hawk (Joanna Frank). The two groups soon put aside their differences to team up against crooked Fillmore (Mel Berger), who employs Marcia and her brother, Johnnie (Robert Walker). But Fillmore decides to encourage dissent among them, arranging for the death of a gang member and framing a Native American -- which leads Kisum to plot an attack on the town. (Action) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Born Losers
screenpixaction.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (Horror) - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

Bobby manages to flee with his daughter, but the Mafia is right behind -- and so is the dog, who remains loyal to the girl. (Drama) - 1994

However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank. (Thriller) - 1995

The two women meet in jail and, despite their mutual animosity, are chained together for transport to a maximum security prison. Their bus is ambushed en route, however, and the pair manages to escape together. Chased by bounty hunters, crooked police and revolutionaries, they struggle to get along and get away. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates. (Action) - 1975

While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger). screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Return of Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit. (Western) - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Fight
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After finishing a stint as a cavalryman, Wayne Santley (James Brown) is looking forward to taking a job on his brother's ranch. While traveling to see his sibling, he helps entertainer Nora (Joan Staley) out of a sticky situation with an aggressive suitor, and promptly falls in love with her. But when he and Nora finally meet up with Wayne's brother, Brad (Gregg Palmer), they learn the ranch is just a front for a crime ring. Wayne is appalled, leading to a feud between the brothers. (Western) - 1961

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Westward Bound

The ranchers, led by feisty Jasper Tuttle (Hal Price) and Enid Barrett (Betty Miles), band together to fight back. With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen. (Western) - 1944

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tomahawk Trail
