SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Malmo, Sweden Tareq is in his hometown of Malmo-Sweden's third largest city. Built upon the backs of herring in the sea, the town is now a centre of culture and technology with a bridge connecting it to Copenhagen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Corn: From The Kernel To The Husk Today is all about corn. Recipes include a refreshing corn zucchini minestra, a polenta cacio e pere, and a mix of vegetables that can be served as a side dish - grilled corn, apricots, and portobello.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Basque Sheperds Cheeses Will visits the pretty village of Espelette to sample its red peppers, before travelling into the mountains to one of the few remaining traditional shepherds huts where where they milk ewe's by hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 The Garden Route A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Alassio In Alassio, everything seems effortlessly perfect. Warm smiles, timeless elegance, and culinary delights define this day dedicated to the pleasures of Riviera life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Taste Of The Tropics: Foodie Friends Cairns chef Davy O'Rourke, who specialises in Mexican and South American cuisines, honours the tradition of his country of birth by cooking a Papua New Guinean mumu under the guidance of his mum.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Autumn Fruit And Veg Simon takes some new seasons vegetables and shows us how to pickle ginger and daikon, while Maggie uses ginger to make an eggplant salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E30 Episode 30 Laura is in the market kitchen making the naughtiest donuts you'll ever see Nutella and Praline Donuts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E30 Bacalao Con Pomodoro Rachael shows how to make Bacalao con Pomodoro, a dish inspired by an amazing meal she shared with John during a special trip to Elba, a Mediterranean island in Tuscany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Manly Cove Hayden starts the day with an early morning run with his running club, before he gets his BBQ on to serve up a glazed salmon side, hot pork rolls, and a mushroom and ricotta pizza.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 What Will People Say Shiva looks inward and contemplates the impacts of living in fear of social judgment and a common reprimand of her childhood, \.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E25 Episode 25 Laura is visited by potato farmer Rene Pye who learns how to make a Chicken & Potato Curry for her family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Featuring Arrnott Olsen, Gary turns to bright coastal flavours with a Fijian fish curry, hiramasa kingfish crudo, and South Indian fish moilee with South Indian red rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E85 Festival Of Lights It's Easy Entertaining with The Cook Up, and Adam is celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, with chefs Gunjan Aylawadi and Nagesh Seethiah.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hotel Chocolat At Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Behind the scenes at Hotel Chocolat as they count down to Christmas. With the ambition to design, make and sell over 50 million chocolates this year, it's going to be a busy time for the team.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Join Adam Liaw as he revisits the highlights from his Scandinavian food adventures.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The World's Biggest Curry Restaurant
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're a nation that loves our curry. But in Greater Manchester, there's one venue that's bigger and bolder than all the rest-The Royal Nawaab.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hong Kong One hundred years ago, there was a Dai Pai Dong, or street food stall, on every Hong Kong street corner, serving up super fast, mouthwatering, and affordable meals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Coromandel Tane comes from the sea with a bag of kai moana. He pulls out a bottle of kombucha and offers it to Sachie, telling her it is made from seaweed. Sachie and Tane collect seaweed.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Lazy Breakfasts Marcus wants to discover unique Mallorcan breakfasts and he begins his search at Mistral, the first cafe on the island to roast their own coffee.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Khanom Wan Experience the streets of Thailand through the eyes of the sellers making some of the country's oldest and most traditional desserts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Black Eyed Pea Biryani Chef Deborah VanTrece brings together Southern and Indian flavours with her black-eyed pea biryani.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts And Festivals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the atmosphere of Diwali.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Under The Pump Seven weeks after opening, the new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Good Friday as fuel costs, wild weather and an auction failure threaten Easter supplies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Thailand And Malaysia Rick takes a train to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong, the culinary icon of Thailand. Later he meets up with one of his cooking heroes, David Thompson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Cuba's Savory Secrets In search of Cuba's most authentic and delicious ingredients, Gordon embraces local ingenuity as he fishes and forages his way across the island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Central Ainsley is in central Malta where he starts his day exploring the beautiful ancient city of Mdina. After a tour of the city, Ainsley stops by a restaurant with an impressive history and a great view.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Dining Alone In The Pacific Northwest Join narrator Maya Rudolph in the Pacific Northwest and explore the best part of dining solo-not having to share any of the juicy pork steak, soba noodles, and piping hot fried chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 The series premiere kicks off with four guest comedians Urzila Carlson, Nazeem Hussain, Danielle Walker and Tom Gleeson where they take on a spelling challenge on Australian currency, and try to make their hometown proud.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Albania Stephen Fry hosts the world's most impossible quiz show. Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Clive Anderson, Linda Smith and Sean Lock.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E11 More Unseen Bits More unseen clips from this series of Would I Lie To You? Joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Greg Davies, Sharon Osborne, Henning Wehn, Simon Day, Dr Ranj Singh, Asim Chaudhry, and Clare Balding.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E22 Curving Bullets Adam and Jamie enlist the Blue Angels to find out if a sonic shock wave can shatter glass; Tory, Grant and Kari try to bend bullets around obstacles.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Altrincham Phil Spencer advises on how to spruce up and sell a three-bedroom detached cottage on the outskirts of Manchester that has been on the market for a staggering four years with no offers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Fire Engine, Shepherd's Hut And Telescope A couple turn an old fire engine into a bar, to raise money for charity. Max builds a shepherds Hut from scratch, including the nuts and bolts! George visits an extraordinary home in Chile and Will builds a telescope.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E4 Caleb Harper, Dami Im, Nikki Britton & Andrew Maxwell We look at Eurovision history. Australia has tonight's guest, Dami Im. Ireland has Dustin the Turkey. Plus, Spacey Jane's Caleb Harper, comedians Nikki Britton and Andrew Maxwell. Julia Jacklin closes the show.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S15 E6 Night David Mitchell, Noel Fielding and Holly Walsh join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig to contemplate the theme of 'night'.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E7 Episode 7 Rob Brydon is back as host with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests John Cooper Clarke, Lucia Keskin, Kadiff Kirwan, and Sara Pascoe.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Keith and Kate have returned to the Scottish seaside town of Dunoon, where her dad grew up and she holidayed annually. But restoring the grand Victorian house they bought comes with costly surprises.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 It's time to fire up the BBQ as the remaining home cooks head outside to create their best BBQ recipes, as judged by frontline volunteers of the SES.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E12 Post Mortem Carter rebukes Benton for his seeming lack of concern over Gant's death. Jeanie hits it off with a handsome infectious disease expert. Carol takes the blame for a patient's death, and Ross considers being Charlie's guardian.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Offsiders
ABCMESydney.au.description: E40 Abbey Gelmi and the panel discuss the week in sport including the Rugby League World Cup Semi Finals, Week 1 of the AFLW Finals, WBBL, team selections ahead of the Australia v England One Day Series and Wallabies Spring Tour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage New Music ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E312 Discover the wildest new music videos on rage. Essential grooves and boundary-pushing visuals from Australia and beyond.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E4 Schooling When Charlie's school gets a bad Ofsted rating, Lee and Lucy start looking around for alternative schools. Geoffrey and Wendy offer to pay to send Charlie to private school, which presents Lee and Lucy with a moral dilemma.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E8 Reflections Sandi Toksvig takes some time to 'reflect' as she asks Alan Davies, Joe Lycett, Zoe Lyons and Liza Tarbuck some impossible and interesting questions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Altrincham Phil Spencer advises on how to spruce up and sell a three-bedroom detached cottage on the outskirts of Manchester that has been on the market for a staggering four years with no offers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Noel It's been five years since we last saw the Worsleys, with Paul and Ally on the verge of splitting and Jim and Jackie in turmoil. Things are no less dramatic now as Luke and girlfriend Maya drop a bombshell at Christmas dinner.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 No Alternative The reality of Luke's announcement hits, and Paul and Ally worry about the decision he and Maya have made. As a New Year starts, the Worsley family gather together with Maya's family, united in their love and worry.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 No Age Ally is appalled that she’s about to turn 50 and bans the family from ever mentioning that number. Paul tries to help Luke, who is overwhelmed by learning to drive and becoming a dad, while Ava meets a charismatic girl called Holly.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Albania Stephen Fry hosts the world's most impossible quiz show. Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Clive Anderson, Linda Smith and Sean Lock.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E8 Crystals Have Power Jake takes a vow of non-violence, which is inconvenient when they're attacked by marauders from the crystal dimension.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 A Tale of Two Ice Bears The Bears accidentally clone Ice Bear and Ice Bear has a hard time adjusting.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E39 What's Opera, Titans? Robin surprises the Titans with a trip to the opera, but they soon fall asleep, and all dream about starring in their own operas.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E8 Meglos: Part 4 The Doctor must convince the Tigellans of his innocence if he is to prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy their world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E25 Logopolis: Part 1 Deciding to repair the TARDIS’s chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth to find a real police box. But an old enemy is one step ahead of him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E26 Logopolis: Part 2 The Doctor travels to the planet Logopolis in the TARDIS where a series of fateful events are set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E27 Logopolis: Part 3 The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet’s secret, but there is more at stake than he realises.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E28 Logopolis: Part 4 With the fate of the entire universe hanging in the balance, the Doctor and the Master are forced to collaborate and return to Earth to carry out their plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E1 Castrovalva: Part 1 The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room, leaving Nyssa, Adric and Tegan to face the Master. Then Adric is taken and the TARDIS plunges towards Event One.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E2 Castrovalva: Part 2 The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor’s regeneration is unstable. To help him, Tegan locates the tranquil world of Castrovalva and the TARDIS heads there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E3 Castrovalva: Part 3 Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help the Doctor identify the problem. And the Master is taunting Adric, caught in his web of power.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E4 Castrovalva: Part 4 As recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva, the Master’s space/time trap is revealed, with Adric at its heart.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E5 Four to Doomsday: Part 1 The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans via their manopticon devices. Intrigued, they begin dividing the Doctor’s friends, and disguising themselves as humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E17 The Horns of Nimon: Part 1 With the TARDIS disabled in order to undergo repairs, the Doctor is powerless when Romana is kidnapped by a battleship which is on its way to Skonnos and the formidable Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E18 The Horns of Nimon: Part 2 On Skonnos, Romana and the Athenian youngsters are forced into the labyrinth of the power complex to meet their fate at the hands of the Nimon.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E19 The Horns of Nimon: Part 3 Trapped inside the power complex, the Doctor and Romana begin to suspect that the Nimon is only the first of a full scale invasion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E20 The Horns of Nimon: Part 4 On the dying world of Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon’s empty promises. The Doctor must find a way to shut down the power complex on Skonnos.

BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E26 Logopolis: Part 2 The Doctor travels to the planet Logopolis in the TARDIS where a series of fateful events are set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E27 Logopolis: Part 3 The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet’s secret, but there is more at stake than he realises.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E28 Logopolis: Part 4 With the fate of the entire universe hanging in the balance, the Doctor and the Master are forced to collaborate and return to Earth to carry out their plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E1 Castrovalva: Part 1 The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room, leaving Nyssa, Adric and Tegan to face the Master. Then Adric is taken and the TARDIS plunges towards Event One.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E2 Castrovalva: Part 2 The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor’s regeneration is unstable. To help him, Tegan locates the tranquil world of Castrovalva and the TARDIS heads there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E3 Castrovalva: Part 3 Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help the Doctor identify the problem. And the Master is taunting Adric, caught in his web of power.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E4 Castrovalva: Part 4 As recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva, the Master’s space/time trap is revealed, with Adric at its heart.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E5 Four to Doomsday: Part 1 The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans via their manopticon devices. Intrigued, they begin dividing the Doctor’s friends, and disguising themselves as humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E6 Four to Doomsday: Part 2 As the Doctor meets the representatives of humanity aboard the Urbankan ship, a Grecian philosopher reveals a bizarre secret about Monarch and his methods.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E7 Four to Doomsday: Part 3 Panicking, Tegan accidentally pilots the TARDIS into space, while Lin Fitu betrays the Doctor and Bigon to Monarch, who demands they be beheaded as punishment.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E8 Four to Doomsday: Part 4 The Doctor takes a dangerous spacewalk to rescue Tegan, while Nyssa ansd Bigon keep the Urbankans distracted and Adric decides exactly whose side he is on.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E9 Kinda: Part 1 While Nyssa rests, Adric and the Doctor discover a military expedition on Deva Loka. Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda, but they cannot stop her dreams.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E10 Kinda: Part 2 Sanders meets Panna and Karuna, who leave a lasting impression on him, while the Dukkha does the same on Tegan. When Hindle’s breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E11 Kinda: Part 3 Aris now carries the mark of the Mara and has gained voice, so Panna shows the Doctor and Todd exactly what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E12 Kinda: Part 4 As the Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension, the Kinda must do everything they can to contain it. Hindle’s need to destroy everything and everyone is unstoppable.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E13 The Visitation: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 17th century England which is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure from behind a holographic wall. The locals seem to be under a strange mesmeric spell.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E14 The Visitation: Part 2 A Terileptil is living in Sir John's basement and is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats. It decides to arrange for the Doctor and Richard Mace to be beheaded.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Godzilla Minus One
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Japan has barely recovered from World War II when a gigantic peril emerges off the coast of Tokyo. Koichi, a deserter traumatised by his first confrontation with Godzilla, sees this as an opportunity to redeem his conduct during the war.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Girls Will Be Girls
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a strict boarding school nestled in the Himalayas, teenager Mira discovers desire and romance. However, Mira's mother, who never got to come of age herself, disrupts her rebellious sexual awakening.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Crow's Egg
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Two boys from the Chennai slums constantly make demands on their family who do what they can to provide. A television inspires a shared dream between them, and they start developing schemes to make enough money to buy a pizza.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Lunchbox
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: After her husband's homemade lunch is mistakenly delivered to someone else, a lonely housewife strikes up a friendship via letters with the recipient.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Bend It Like Beckham
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: An Asian teenager cannot tell her traditionally-minded parents that she has joined a women's football team.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Hindi Vindi
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A Sydney teenager bridges cultural gaps through music when he creatively fuses Australian hip-hop with traditional Hindi songs to connect with his beloved grandmother.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brassed Off
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The threat of a coal mine closure in a small Yorkshire village strikes a sour note with the miners' brass band, who are preparing for a national competition.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Operation Napoleon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A lawyer is sucked into an international conspiracy after being accused of a murder she didn't commit. Her only chance of survival lies in uncovering the secret of an old German WWII aeroplane discovered on Iceland's largest glacier.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: When Will It Be Again Like It Never Was Before
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Joachim's family home is on the grounds of a psychiatric hospital, where his father is the director. Joachim's unconventional upbringing sees him plagued by fits of anger and sadness.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E44 Things The Teletubbies find different uses for their favourite things and a child in Tummy Tales makes a seaside picture out of lots of things from a make-and-do box. In Teletubbyland a large tube appears.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Crystal Cavern Caper / A Banner Moment A crab steals Ariel's treasures. Ariel leads a parade.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E12 Cousins at the Castle Prince Wednesday needs to get dressed before he can go outside to see the butterflies and play with Chrissie.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie & Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Knock Knock Maddie + Triggs sing about all the things they love about their favourite travelling Uncle George, as they wait, and wait, and wait. for his latest letter to arrive.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Mr Elf Takes a Holiday Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased. Mrs Elf and Ben however are overjoyed at the news. Meanwhile Nanny takes over the food deliveries.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 The Missing Life Day Feast, The/ Lost Treasure Of Tenoo The Jedi must stop pirates from ruining Life Day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E2 Who Let the Moths In? With Motsuki's help, the moths infiltrate HQ and Gekko won't admit that he let them in until it is too late.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Siberian Salamander While trying to rescue Paani's science equipment from an icy river in Siberia, he, Inkling, Peso and Dashi discover a frozen salamander. The salamander safely exits the ice, and everyone's focus shifts to explosive craters.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S25 E47 More Cowbell Thomas is elated when he finds a cowbell on the side of the tracks, until his friends start hogging it.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E14 Rockets and Rekenreks Ten launches her rocket rides into space using a Rekenrek.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E13 Dogs: The Musical Mittens, Scarf and Sock just got back from the big city where they saw Dogs: The Musical. They try to act itout for Pants, but it doesn't go so well, till Pants has an idea.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fantus And The Machines
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Wheel Loader Go with Fantus to see what a wheel loader does.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Musical Instruments Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig find an old box full of musical instruments. Mummy plays the violin, Daddy plays the accordion and Peppa bangs the drum. But no one can play the Swiss horn.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E3 Wiggly Superheroes Join The Wiggles for this Superhero Adventure! With a bedsheet to make a cape, and a bit of imagination and Sunflower Power to make their superhero powers, they're ready to help out their friends!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E27 Save the Dump When the prospect of the Farmer's new golf course ruining their dump begins to become a reality, Shaun and the Flock have to resort to canny ways to save their prized resources.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Swing with a Stomp During the concert, Doc Ock steals the drumset and uses it to hypnotize the entire audience!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Wishing Tree Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli's help to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 Museum Mayhem / Big Dig Lab Rat and Ginny learn what makes their art special. Sparks learns to share his upset feelings.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Ben's Birthday Card Holly forgets Ben's birthday, and rushes home to make him a birthday card. But Nanny has stopped all magic, so Holly has to make the card herself. When she takes the card to Ben she is embarrassed that it is hand-made.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Ghost Pumpkin Flower and Unicorn Cuzzy decide to create creepy faces on pumpkins for the Spooky Night Party coming up. But they freak out when one of their pumpkins seems to come to life!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Little Sister When Flower begs her parents for a little sister, she borrows Tutu for the day to see what it's like; but chaos quickly erupts. In the end, Flower realizes she already has the perfect playmate: Flour.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E42 The Owl Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig build a special bird watching hut so that they can spot an owl at night.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E43 The Apple Tree Peppa and family enjoy their garden apple tree all year round, through Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Wagon Ride Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Taxi Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Hatchling When an egg cracks to reveal a baby Avocadodon, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes have to find a fun way to lead the energetic baby back to its herd.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Dance Off Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes guide a young Strawberrisaurus to find the courage to perform a special friendship dance that will help them find a lifelong playmate.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 The Fun Doctor When Mara calls Pearl sensible, she wants to prove how fun she is. With her eye off the ball, Pearl starts to make medical mistakes. Can she be a fun doctor?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 The Snowman Badge The Squirrels make a snow slug and the penguins make a snow bird. Each new snow creation trumps the last, they get bigger, better, more exciting. And in the end, they make an enormous snow slide together!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Song of Peace Betty recalls the first time she pushed the BIG RED BUTTON, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story and the gerbils sing a song of peace and unity.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 Electricity Fizzy and Suds follow power lines to explore wind and solar energy, watch a firefly animation, and use balloons to discover the magic of static electricity. Zap-tastic!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E13 Big And Small: Sea Miah and Michelle explore all things big and small in the sea! Michelle makes a small sailboat, and races Miah's big tugboat. In the big Play School pop-up book a little boat sails in the big blue sea.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Cloud The Piggies create a floating cushion for Fiona, who wishes to be on a cloud. But Wilf falls asleep on it, and they now must catch the cloud before it drifts away!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 To The Lighthouse / The Golden Giant When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. / When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Caravan Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure but they don't know where to go!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Wedding Party! Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow surprise everyone with their wedding announcement and everyone rallies around to make it memorable!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Mecha Machine Makers Izzy and Timmy are making a bird caller for Grandma, but need the Mechas to help connect pieces of their machine.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Nikhil and Jay and the Missing Appalams Nikhil and Jay are detectives today. When the homemade appalams go missing under their watch, they need to solve the case and save lunch!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 The Most Magnificent Game Millie helps Maya find a new home for some old toys by creating a toy shop and a life-sized game on their sidewalk.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Stan & Gran Grumblestunk is getting competitive during 'Porthole In Bloom', but so are the local robins! Why are the red-chested birds turning on each other?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Grandma's Fun And Games Miffy and her friends go to Miffy's grandparent's house to play with a \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 Forgittin’ Kitten Mittens' wasn't listening to where her parents said to meet them. Pants tries to help her find them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Night Night Pants When Pants goes to Mittens' house for a sleepover, Mittens' wants to show him the best time, but her cat house just wasn't built for dogs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E18 Five Little Wiggles Anthony and Dorothy the Dinosaur are in the Wiggly Kitchen and someone calls Anthony to tell him the Little Wiggles are jumping on the bed, who could it be? The Dancing Water Police are here to help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Today Fantus meets a cow, a pig and a hen.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E25 Octonaughty and the Fractionator Octonaughty uses his new invention, the Fractionator, to break into The Museum of Numbers to steal the Golden Infinity. But has he met his match when he splits Octoblock into four equal parts?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Science Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Salty Sea Turtle Why do objects sink or float? Dive on in with Rachael 'eggs-perimenting' with water density using eggs, salt and water. Turn your egg into a sea turtle and see if it will sink or float!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E33 Peppa Goes to Paris Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E34 Grandpa Pig's Pond Peppa and George are helping Grandpa pig to dig a brand new pond for his garden!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Bed Time Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly. But the real problems begin when they start sleepwalking.right into harm's way!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 The Toy Robot Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would, and soon it is trying to clean out the whole castle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Por Por Day Flower can't wait for Por Por Day, expecting a lazy day of treats, but she's surprised when her grandmother reveals she has a packed schedule planned!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E9 Cat's Pajamas Cat Burglar and a mystery thief compete to steal the Kittydale Banner.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 The Pirate Painter Santi and crew must save the town and everyone in it from having their colour drained.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 Bastet By The Book Bastet wants to find desert magic in a rare book and thinks it is only for her.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E42 Simon Says Simon finds Bok in the Wiggly Kitchen; he loves to play 'Simon Says' - join in and play along too! Simon is worried about Bok as he is very quiet, will the 'Wiggle Groove' help Bok get his groove back?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Today Fantus meets a duck, a fish and a beaver.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E26 You're Five Ones and I'm Five Tens Superstar Fifty sings a song that shows Five the pattern that makes them similar in so many ways and how, If you can count to five, you can count to fifty!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Science Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Shadows Ever wondered why objects cast shadows? Luke is bringing to light some interesting findings through shadow play, as he experiments with simple objects and a torch to better understand the science behind shadows.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E35 Once Upon A Time Peppa and her family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E36 Police Station Oh, no! George has lost Mr Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E28 Breakfast Kiri and Lou have a wild adventure delivering a giant fruit to Pania.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 The Nest Minty tries to fly and is mistaken for a Baby Bokchoydacty by its mother who takes Minty back to their nest. Ginger needs a rescue plan and fast!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Big Bad Barry King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, baddest fish ever - Big Bad Barry. The King wants to catch Barry for supper.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 Flour's Fun List Flower writes a Pet Day 'fun list' for Flour, but quickly discovers that letting him choose his own fun is way better than sticking to a list.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 Country Kitty To guard a new dinosaur bone, Buddy must learn to pay attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E29 The Fruit Festival Santiago and his family team up to save the Fruit Festival when Enrique crashes the party and steals all the fruit!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E42 Romeovision Romeo invents a device that traps the PJM inside TV shows. It's the perfect plan, until he gets trapped inside too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E6 The Octonauts And The Artificial Reef When an underwater hurricane destroys a small reef, which a frogfish and other creatures depend on, Tweak and her crew must convert the recently destroyed Gup-F into an artificial reef before the hurricane strikes again!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 The Rain Dance Badge When Duggee's flowers look very sad, everyone does a rain dance to help make it rain.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E8 Monster Toad A day at the lake turns into chaos when Frizzy and Spyke become convinced there's a monster toad prowling the lake, the Cadets must uncover the truth behind the mysterious phantom frog.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E19 I'm the Captain A lovely day out at sea turns into a major ocean rescue when Mandy and Norman tussle over who should be captain!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 Nikhil and Jay and the Portrait Nikhil has never painted a portrait of Jay before because Jay can't stay still enough! After trying lots of ways to keep his brother still, Nikhil finds the perfect solution.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E80 Divide and Drive Three invites the other Numberblocks to her super new go-kart track.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Makery
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Soup A cheeky mole pinches one of Nim's carrots! So, Nim gets inspired to make a \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Balls Balls are so much fun to play with! Bowling balls, bouncing balls, basketballs, disco balls! Fizzy and Suds play with all their favourite balls!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School: Magnificent Monsters and More!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S379 E4 Lights, Camera, Monsters! Emma and Teo are decorating mechanical monster trucks in the Cubby Cave! Teo pretends to be a robot, and Emma and Teo make a film about a friendly monster called \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Thomas And Friends: Really Helpful Engines When Gordon has an unexpected engine breakdown, Thomas insists on doing all of Gordon's big jobs by himself. Thomas soon realizes that the jobs are too much to handle alone and he almost risks a crash!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E47 Ginger Has Questions Now that Ginger knows his friends are the Peak City Heroes, he wants to know everything about them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dance Mashup Big Cuz feels way too shy to dance in the school culture concert.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Football Fantastics ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Loop, Swoop and Pull Elvis has forgotten his trainers and has to wear a pair with laces but can't tie them without his Gran's help. He has to learn quickly to tie them himself if he wants to get a PB.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Blackout The plaza is having a blackout! Flower helps Rudy face his fear of the dark, while Flour sees the blackout as the perfect chance to snatch up all the abandoned dinners.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E18 Soil Day Spa Clarence and the kids learn all about regenerative farming and treat the soil to a pampering session. Then they create their own day spa to treat themselves.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E51 Monkey Trees Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and with her guidance and safety harnesses they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E53 Canoe Trip Peppa and her family are going on a canoe trip. They hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit and head down river on their canoe adventure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Big BIG Family Tree When the littlecorns make family trees at kindy school, Andrew wants to learn more about the rhino family he originally came from.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Wiggly Fruit Salad
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Get ready to wiggle with all your wiggly friends as they perform as part of their Wiggly Big Day Out show. Featuring Wiggles classics such as Rock-a-Bye Your Bear and Fruit Salad, as well as new hits like Hey Tsehay!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School Show Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Dr. Chris Brown Dr Chris Brown introduces some native Australian animals - a ringtail possum, a blue tongue lizard and a cheeky galah named Rosie! Then get your frilled fingers ready for Chris and Rosie's version of 'Frill Neck Lizard'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E15 Saturday Night Shaun Shaun finds the Farmer's old record player on the dump and organises a rave in the barn. But trouble looms when the Naughty Pigs gatecrash the party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Hospital Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy, leaving Bluey no choice but to operate immediately!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Fifi's Delivery Service Fifi needs to exercise but has a cart full of pies to deliver. Zog and the doctors must help her before her creaking bones turn to stone forever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 The Taste Badge Duggee is making a smoothie and the Squirrels can't agree on whether it's delicious or horrible, so they make their own adventurous smoothies showcasing their favourite flavours to discover what taste is.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Grumpy Grampa Buns and Blossom accidentally get Rhonda's gooey honey stuck to their bums. But when they need to cheer up a friend's grandpa, Superbuns convinces her sister that laughing at themselves is exactly what they need to do!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Fireworks Fright Mr. Puppypaws steals all of Kittydale's fireworks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Vanish When Wizz loses Mr Goblin's bike and doesn't say sorry, everything around him begins to disappear. Can he break the curse before there's nothing left?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Hammerbarn On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour Bingo.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 The Top Of The Fireman's Pole After Mrs Gonsha bravely rescues a tiny boy from the top of the playground equipment, she can't get down herself. The children realise that Mrs Gonsha isn't stuck, but too scared to move as she's terrified of heights.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 The Shilling Test A spy wreaks havoc in the school. Gabriel's search for his parents leads him into the heart of Crookhaven. Edgar will stop at nothing to win the Shilling Test.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark? ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 The Tale of the Night Frights As the Midnight Society digs deeper into the mystery, they discover themselves haunted by an evil entity known as the Shadowman.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ice Age: A Frozen World
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 The Great Thaw It's the epic end to the Ice Age as we see how The Great Thaw changed Earth as we know it. Witness the flooding of the Ice Age world and the birth of the modern age and learn whether our planet could face another Ice Age.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Knock Your Shocks Off The MythBusters delve into the little known world of shockwaves, testing if an underwater explosion can be survived by diving deep; if an explosive wave can be surfed; and more.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Sieges This time The Slow Mo Guys go barricading and look at the amazing world of Sieges. How far can a Trebuchet, a huge medieval contraption, fire a flaming rock?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E4 Episode 4 In this show, the former holiday camp Bluecoats dare to flip two of the House Robots with their 'launcher' Apollo. Engineering students have created a future tech machine that uses mecanum motion to move in any direction.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E9 College Dropouts and the Medford Miracle Sheldon considers dropping out of college to focus on building his database. Also, George Sr. is frustrated when someone else gets credit for his football wins.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E62 Anti-Bullying Campaign Bullying can leave a lasting mark on all of us. We meet Raghu from Project Rockit to hear about his personal journey and his recent involvement with the government's new bullying awareness campaign.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E24 True Blue Swablu May feels a special duty to help a wounded Swablu return to its flock.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 Turn Anger Into Power! Vegeta's All-Out Battle! Vegeta prepares to face Frost, who has no intention of discontinuing his cheating. But with a single hit, Vegeta knocks Frost completely out of the ring for the win.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E11 The Demon Chloe and Ice Bear accidentally lose Chloe's prized hoodie.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E13 The Limo Grizz and Ice Bear treat Panda to a ride in a limo.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Body Adventure Robin shrinks to cell size to fight Cyborg's infection.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E51 Hafo Safo The Titans travel to the hipster neighborhood of Silver Lake, California, to help solve a mystery.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E8 Space House - Part 1 The Titans set off on an adventure in space, only to discover they’ll be sharing their space pad with the DC Superhero Girls. The two teams must then figure out what goes bump in the night.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E19 For a Few Duncans More While trying to photocopy his butt on Chef's fancy new copier, Duncan accidentally makes an entire other Duncan - great! This other Duncan can do all the school stuff while the real Duncan chills.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Tiara Trouble A magic tiara causes trouble in a beauty pageant.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 The Sisters Darrell is determined to give her sister Felicity a jolly fun time when she visits, but with Miss Johnson's rules in force they have to resort to drastic measures!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 My Two Favorite People Jake wants Finn and Lady Rainicorn to be friends, so he can spend time with both of them. But Jake gets very jealous when they become buddies, and will do anything to split them apart.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Operation Ouch!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S12 E5 Eyeball Action The Operation Ouch! 3D cinema is open! But how do you see the world in three dimensions? Find out as the Doctors reveal the incredible eye muscles that control how you focus on things close-up and far away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Case Of The Pestering Prank Caller When a prank caller targets Ezra and his neighbours, Maudie believes the Inbestigators can track down who is making the mystery calls.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E02 When The Music Stops When an aspiring rapper is found dead during a shootout at the Metropolitan Studios in Atlanta, detectives must follow a trail of lies, ultimately discovering a cold-blooded betrayal at the heart of the murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E03 The Star Recruit When a 17-year-old military recruit and homecoming queen is gunned down outside her home, the community is stunned; but as detectives look closer into those around her, they uncover a complex web of relationships that may lead to her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E04 Murder on Welcome All Road When a veteran is found dead in the back of a pickup truck in Southwest Atlanta, investigators must untangle a web of secrets that leads straight to a suspect with close ties to the victim.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E05 Halloween Horror After a young woman finds a human foot on her porch the night before Halloween, detectives race to identify the scattered remains and uncover a killer who'll do anything to bury the truth.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E06 A Mother's Nightmare When a beloved member of the Covington church community discovers her son murdered inside their home, everyone is shocked.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E08 Lost & Found When a devoted mother vanishes on the 10th anniversary of her cousin's disappearance, detectives race against the clock to untangle a set of mysterious clues culminating in an undercover operation to find the missing mom.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E10 Horror at the Mall A 28-year-old mother vanishes without a trace, only to turn up murdered and left at an Atlanta area mall; when DNA points to a suspect who's never met her, investigators must look beyond the physical evidence to uncover an even deeper mystery.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 The Brother's Keeper The brutal murders of two Atlanta brothers leave detectives searching for a dangerous predator. But as the investigation unfolds, every assumption is challenged until an unimaginable betrayal comes to light.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E28 The Family Secret It is common for long-haul truck driver Lloyd Ford to be gone for stretches, and when he disappears, it doesn't raise many flags; at least two people know where he is, and they guard the secret for 27 years, but the truth is about to be revealed.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E24 A Family's Story Two years after the disappearance of his wife, Josh Powell kills his two sons and himself.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Kimberly Warth When Las Vegas Police respond to a self-defense shooting, the case appears open and shut; following the discovery of bombshell video evidence that contradicts the shooter's initial story, a mother's desperation for him.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 Cynthia Cdebaca When a California man is found riddled with bullets in his own home, the investigation leads to an unconventional suspect close to the victim; a bizarre interrogation leaves a daughter heartbroken by the actions her mother took to protect her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Kelly Turner When a Colorado mother claims her daughter is mysteriously ill, doctors question if they have a Munchausen by proxy case; the investigation reveals the horrific truth behind the lengths a mother is willing to go with her child's life for attention.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scandals ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 The Dr. Phil Show Pt. 1 An investigation uncovers troubling allegations about the long-running hit daytime series "The Dr. Phil Show" while former show guests reveal shocking behind-the-scenes experiences of coercion and humiliation.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scandals ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 The Dr. Phil Show Pt. 2 The investigation continues, as suspicious relationships emerge between The Dr. Phil Show and its preferred treatment facilities; one family's trust in televised help leads to years of suffering.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 The Hometown Hero When a promising young boxer is found murdered after arranging a date on Facebook, detectives follow his digital trail and uncover a sinister deception that suggests he may not have been the only target.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 A Hopeless Romantic A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online; her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Killer Profile When an Arizona corrections officer vanishes after leaving for a hot date, investigators uncover blood in the desert, a digital phantom named Paige, and a predator lurking in plain sight.

oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E20 Lone Star Obsession Part 1 When a pathologist is found murdered in his home, the investigation reveals simmering jealousies and a love triangle.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E20 Lone Star Obsession Part 1 When a pathologist is found murdered in his home, the investigation reveals simmering jealousies and a love triangle.

oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E11 Death in the Driveway Former mayor and prominent attorney Melvin Roberts is larger than life; when cops find him dead in his driveway, it marks the start of a tough case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S05 E20 The Vow Two sisters determined to fulfill a promise investigate the mystery surrounding their mother's death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E02 12 Minutes on Elm Street Byron Smith claims he shot two teenagers in self-defense when they broke into his home on Thanksgiving Day, but investigators suspect there's more to his story.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
oxygenwest.us.description: As Hooters reached its peak in the 2000s, several women who worked at Hooters were targeted by predators and murdered in cold blood; a look at how women who worked at the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Beloved Veteran Kelly and the team help the Lake Station Police department look into the 2007 slaying of a kind-hearted WWII veteran killed with a sledgehammer; tracing the purchases on his stolen credit card may be the key to solving the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E02 Silenced The team helps the Abilene Police Department investigate the heartbreaking double homicide of a devoted mother and her young daughter strangled in their home; DNA evidence left at the scene might help identify their killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E03 Killer at the Door Kelly and Steve join the Kankakee Police Department to help a woman who just missed seeing her mother's killer at their front door when she was 11 years old; decades later, efforts are made to recall any clues to help crack the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E04 Enemy Next Door Kelly and Steve extend their stay in Illinois to help the Kankakee Police Department look into another mysterious case -- the unsolved homicide of a mother-to-be and her unborn child.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E05 Some Kind of Monster Kelly, Tonya and the Alcoa Police Department investigate the 1990 rape and murder of a beloved 80-year-old grandmother and consider if the perpetrator may have been a sadistic random intruder or a member of her own family.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E06 The Reporter Beautiful, ambitious reporter Jennifer Servo is shockingly murdered in 2002; Kelly and Steve are determined to help the Abilene Police Department catch her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 The Texas Seven After seven inmates escape a Texas prison, their crime spree results in the murder of a police officer; a nationwide manhunt leads to six capital murder trials, as one prosecutor must prove how each of the six can be responsible for one murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E02 Deadly Deception The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

wgxa.us.title: Access Hollywood

The show is hosted by Mario Lopez, Kit Hoover, Scott Evans and Zuri Hall. The Emmy Award-nominated, daily, half-hour syndicated program delivers the inside scoop on the latest breaking entertainment news. "Access" also delves into the latest true crime headlines with insight from leading experts, celebrates local heroes working to make their communities better, and speaks with the people behind the viral moments everyone is talking about. In 2021, "Access Hollywood" was honored at the annual CultureX Conversation Conference with the award for Program Reflection of Inclusion in Television by Multichannel News and Broadcasting + Cable. Instead, host Sharyl Attkisson -- a veteran journalist who has won multiple Emmy Awards for investigative journalism -- fronts a newsmagazine-style program that features long-form reports from her and a team of correspondents. fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: The Invitation
fxm.us.description: After the death of her mother and having no other known relatives, Evie takes a DNA test and discovers a long-lost cousin she never knew she had. Invited by her newfound family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, Evie's at first seduced by the sexy aristocratic host. However, she's soon thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets about her family history and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
fxm.us.description: Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night. (Horror, Action) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters II
fxm.us.description: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

fxm.us.title: FXM Presents
fxm.us.description: An examination of the process of making movies follows a production from script to screen. (Entertainment) - 2012-01-01

fxm.us.title: Fantastic Voyage
fxm.us.description: The brilliant scientist Jan Benes develops a way to shrink humans, and other objects, for brief periods of time. Benes, who is working in communist Russia, is transported by the CIA to America, but is attacked en route. In order to save the scientist, who has developed a blood clot in his brain, a team of Americans in a nuclear submarine is shrunk and injected into Benes' body. They have a finite period of time to fix the clot and get out before the miniaturization wears off. (Science fiction) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Day Mars Invaded Earth

(Drama) - 2004

365blk.us.title: Showtime

365blk.us.title: Brooklyn's Finest

365blk.us.title: Law Abiding Citizen
365blk.us.description: Ten years after his wife and child die in a home invasion, a man carries out an elaborate plot against the prosecutor who cut a deal with one of the killers. - 2009

365blk.us.title: Ricochet
365blk.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

365blk.us.title: 16 Blocks
365blk.us.description: Boozy and world-weary, NYPD Detective Jack Mosley (Bruce Willis) draws a routine assignment to transport trial witness Eddie Bunker (Mos Def) to the courthouse by 10 a.m. The task quickly becomes a deadly game of cat-and-mouse when some of Jack's fellow officers arrive to kill Eddie so that he cannot testify against them. Jack sees a way to redeem his wasted life by protecting the affable Eddie from the would-be assassins. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2006

365blk.us.title: Romeo Must Die

But when the first casualty is the Asian warlord's son, the gang war becomes more dangerous than either side ever imagined. (Action) - 2000

365blk.us.title: Three Kings
365blk.us.description: Just after the end of the Gulf War, four American soldiers decide to steal a cache of Saddam Hussein's hidden gold. Led by Sergeant Major Archie Gates, three of the men are rescued by rebels, but Sergeant Troy Barlow is captured and tortured by Iraqi intelligence. The Iraqi rebels beg for the American trio to help fight against the impending arrival of Hussein's Elite Guard. The men agree to fight in return for help rescuing Troy. (War, Comedy drama) - 1999
