5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: Internet users watch six collegians as they spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home. - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind. - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice. - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve. - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: With the sitter dead, a Los Angeles teen (Christina Applegate) lands a job in the fashion industry to feed her siblings. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
5starmax.us.description: Filmmakers Albert Maysles, David Maysles and Charlotte Zwerin show the Rolling Stones' 1969 California concert. - 1970

5starmax.us.title: Take the Lead
5starmax.us.description: Renowned ballroom dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a job at a New York City public school and helps his students meld hip-hop and classical styles to create a dance form. - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Collision Course
5starmax.us.description: A Japanese detective (Pat Morita) and a Detroit detective (Jay Leno) team up to recover a stolen top-secret turbocharger. - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
5starmax.us.description: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life. - 1999

5starmax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
5starmax.us.description: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves. - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Robin Hood
5starmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Hitcher
5starmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: It
5starmax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

5starmax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
5starmax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Catfish
5starmax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
5starmax.us.description: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other. (Drama) - 1985

antennatv.us.title: Bewitched
antennatv.us.description: Samantha falls in love with New York ad exec Darrin Stephens and marries him in the first episode of the sitcom. Then Darrin finds out that his new bride is one of a secret society of powerful witches and warlocks and that a twitch of her nose brings magic results. Thoroughly befuddled, Darrin makes her promise never to use her powers. She agrees and tries to settle into being the perfect suburban housewife. Her mother, Endora, however, has a different agenda. She hates that Samantha has married a mortal and continually tries to break them up. Sam's other spellbinding friends and family pop in and out of the Stephens household as Sam tries (and most of the time fails) to live without magic. (Sitcom, Fantasy, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 1964-09-17

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. O'Laskey II), Rocky (Mathew Botuchis) and Tum Tum (Victor Wong) go to an amusement park to get a glimpse of their idol, action star Dave Dragon (Hulk Hogan). But when evil masterminds Medusa (Loni Anderson) and Lothar Zogg (Jim Varney) descend on the park, the boys are thrust into a real-life shoot-'em-up. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 1995-03-10

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance
cinevault.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 1985

cinevault.us.title: Guarding Tess
cinevault.us.description: Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-04-30

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days

(Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Legion

As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it. (Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-01-22

As he begins to recover, he learns he has been framed for the stick-up; distraught, Felix decides to find the real culprit himself, despite his failing health and memory. divorcecourt.us.description: Muriel is fed up with Nikkinba's indecisiveness and accuses him of cheating; he says she is controlling and is continually breaking his phones; he quit his job and told her he was leaving her for a new life in North Carolina, then changed his mind.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Lawrence vs. Lawrence
divorcecourt.us.description: Keith says he has a pass from God to have as many wives as he wishes, but Paw'lla is done with his cheating and giving money to other women.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Cordova vs. Morris
divorcecourt.us.description: Robert is no longer willing to be in an open marriage, but Diana isn't ready to compromise her invitations to other men.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Winborn vs. Winborn
divorcecourt.us.description: Christy is done with Demetrice's nonstop obsession with his video games; he says she is just too bossy and insecure, and he is better off with his head in his game than being accused of looking at every woman who passes by.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Parker vs. Barksdale
divorcecourt.us.description: Ebony says she is getting tired of being the parent in the relationship, while Gary claims she's verbally abusive and acts like a dictator, and he is frustrated with her never-ending disrespectful comments.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Douglas vs. Kirksey
divorcecourt.us.description: No matter how hard Demont tries, he's always looking up at the bar Reasha keeps raising, and the romance took a hard turn into a wall when Demont got a promotion and relocated for work, which raised her suspicions of him cheating.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brickle vs. Banks
divorcecourt.us.description: La'Tanya is honest with Jonathan about her sexual attraction to women, which gives him serious concerns about going forward, and the final straw was when her kids came home singing "Jonathan is a bad daddy," even though he supports the family.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kraudel vs. Hodge
divorcecourt.us.description: Romeo says much-younger Emily breaks up with him at least three times a day, and he doesn't invite her to parties, because she's an attention hound, breaking out in song and doing backflips, and it's embarrassing.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Umbles vs. Umbles
divorcecourt.us.description: Corey has cheated on his wife with 27 women but wants a divorce because she had one affair, and he no longer trusts her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Molyneaux vs. Rivera
divorcecourt.us.description: Brianna says Steven constantly looks at other women, and his continued selfishness has caused her to frequently doubt her beauty and value; he says her unrelenting overprotectiveness leads to arguments that end up with her accusing him of cheating.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Bellamy vs. Roberts
divorcecourt.us.description: Maria says Herb's over-active sex drive is out of control, and it's ruining their relationship, because she needs to give her body a rest; when he doesn't get his way, he throws major tantrums, once leaving her stranded out of town all alone.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hecker vs. Secor
divorcecourt.us.description: Shea says Jessica constantly punishes him because of her history of cheating exes: she must know where he is every second of the day, forcing his friends to cut ties; she says she caught him lying to her, and his extreme laziness doesn't help.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tate vs. Steward
divorcecourt.us.description: Erin feels like Timothy doesn't care about the relationship, and she's considering moving on; he is tired of being kicked out of the house every time she catches an attitude; she dropped out of college and left behind a scholarship because of him.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tarquino vs. Rose
divorcecourt.us.description: Quanasia can no longer deal with Chandler's over-the-top compulsive lying just so he can have affairs; he says she lost her drive after having his children, and he needs to keep his options open because he wants a woman who can pull the same weight.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Allen vs. Vizuela
divorcecourt.us.description: Kayla's excessive drinking and cheating are dealbreakers for Bryan, and he can no longer tolerate her outbursts of anger; she says he is extremely controlling, doesn't trust her, and no longer spends time with her and their child.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Winfrey vs. Moore
divorcecourt.us.description: Kelley says Keionte's immature and childish behavior has her considering burning their marriage license; he told her he no longer wants to be her business partner, because she has taken on the role of his mother, and he hates it.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hall vs. Hall
divorcecourt.us.description: Dwight says he has had it with Roxy's mental abuse -- she has cost him multiple jobs because she's constantly harassing him at work; she says he needs to man up and give her the attention she deserves or else she's gone.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Behm vs. Futch
divorcecourt.us.description: Jennifer says Josh's constant lies have left their family homeless; he has gone behind her back and made many hurtful decisions, like selling her car and abandoning her dog in a village while she was in the hospital giving birth to their son.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Beale vs. Watson
divorcecourt.us.description: Devonte says Alyssia doesn't trust him and stalks his social media because he has cheated in the past; they share a child, but Devonte doesn't want to commit if Alyssia can't change, as he has no problem being single.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Henderson vs. Henderson

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Price vs. Price
divorcecourt.us.description: Krystal holds resentment toward Caleb for proposing only after her father's death, while Caleb is having a hard time dealing with Krystal controlling all their finances.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hawkins vs. Hawkins

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Johnson vs. Johnson
divorcecourt.us.description: Tamara claims Jasmine sends inappropriate texts to other women and men; Jasmine says Tamara can explode from 0 to 100 in fits of rage.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hays vs. Jackson
divorcecourt.us.description: Porcha has had it with her boyfriend's insecurities and manipulative ways; she says his promiscuous behavior is no longer allowed under her roof.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandenberg vs. Brandenberg
divorcecourt.us.description: Victoria feels like she's been conned by the man who once swept her off her feet, while Casey feels like a slave to her because she makes more money than him.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ervin vs. Bair
divorcecourt.us.description: Khasha says Jermaine is always too busy for her, while Jermaine says Khasha is extremely messy and has a disrespectful demeanor.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Wright vs. McFadden
divorcecourt.us.description: Jazmin wants to trust Darren but can't because he has cheated with multiple women; Darren feels he's a good father who pays the bills, so he doesn't have to answer to anyone.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chimira J. Glazebrook vs. Bennie I. McCormick
divorcecourt.us.description: Doug has been fired from two jobs over allegations of sexual misconduct; he claims he is innocent, but his fiancé Tasha isn't so sure.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Frazier vs. Thomas
divorcecourt.us.description: Selina calls her boyfriend, Derrick, in the early hours of the morning to make sure another female isn't keeping him company; Derrick admits he sees other women, but he doesn't consider it cheating because he's not having sex.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Benjamin vs. Stevens
divorcecourt.us.description: Quey loves Floyd, but his jealousy is leading her to consider ending their three-year commitment: she says she's becoming an alcoholic because of his controlling ways; he says she pushed him to become this way because he's caught her in a few lies. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-21

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ward vs. Greaves-Brown
divorcecourt.us.description: Latoya wants Davarius to become a stay-at-home dad, because he can't keep a job; he says she sabotages any work he can get and goes out of her way to create hostile environments. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-22

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kaplan vs. Green
divorcecourt.us.description: Cheryl is fed up with Cody's drinking and lack of affection, and she believes he's cheating; they lost their home, and he pressured her to leave her 7-year-old daughter in Ohio as they moved miles away to live with his family. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-23

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Gray vs. Walker
divorcecourt.us.description: Kadaveion and Justice's anger issues are tearing them apart, and now he is questioning the paternity of their 1-year-old child; she says he is a disrespectful liar who gave her an STD; he says she is mean, cold and argumentative. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-24

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hall vs. Parker
divorcecourt.us.description: Even though they are engaged, Rechene does not trust Itarous because of his constant lying; he says that she is too immature and that she's not ready for an adult relationship. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Scott vs. McFarthing
divorcecourt.us.description: Clifford says Asia is always searching for things that aren't there; she says she is done with him and the way he uses social media to flirt and cheat. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-30

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hightower-Bey vs. Nelson
divorcecourt.us.description: Mali still wants to party, and Zay is ready to settle down; he says if she can't get rid of her clingy ways, he's done. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Martinez vs. Cook
divorcecourt.us.description: Nathaniel says America is always flirting with other men and came home with a hickey one night after she slept with a woman; she is ready to hit the road if he cannot get his anger issues into check. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-04

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Garrett vs. Garrett
divorcecourt.us.description: Jacoby says wife Kim has stolen money from the household to feed her gambling addiction; Kim says she is still scratching her head as to why Jacoby's mother badmouths her to everyone. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-05

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Garrett vs. Garrett
divorcecourt.us.description: Jacoby is fighting to save his marriage of 15 years; meanwhile, his wife, Kim, has her belongings packed and is waiting for the moving truck. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-06

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Harper vs. McCormick
divorcecourt.us.description: Raymond is an Instagram sensation who says his high-school sweetheart is jealous of his social media fan base; Christian accuses him of cheating with his followers; Ray thinks Christian is living a double life. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-07

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mendez vs. Graham
divorcecourt.us.description: Briana and Giovanni suspect each other of cheating; she admits to using a dating app to see if she could find someone with more money. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-29

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - McClain vs. Lanier
divorcecourt.us.description: The breaking point came when LaSonya learned that another woman was three weeks pregnant with her husband's baby; he says she would be happier if she had more self-esteem. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-12

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ellis vs. Hill
divorcecourt.us.description: Syncere says Mark has lied and disrespected her on several occasions, and she's not going to stand for it anymore; he says he cheats on her because she has a bad attitude, and she gets on his nerves. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-13

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Powers vs. Powers
divorcecourt.us.description: Willard says he's tired of his roller coaster ride of a relationship with Cynthia, and he's had as much as he can take with her lies and deception; she says she's doing her best to regain his trust, but he is always reaching back to the past. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-14

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Watts vs. Whitsett
divorcecourt.us.description: Dermartess abandoned Rofiesha and their children seven years ago: she has not seen him in seven years and wants a divorce; he says he still loves her and wants to see his children but blames her for his abandoning them. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jacobs vs. Jacobs
divorcecourt.us.description: Clancy asserts that Layaloni is selfish and complains about everything; she professes that he is a good-for-nothing drunk who's always running around with other women behind her back, and he's perpetually broke. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-18

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Wright vs. Vance
divorcecourt.us.description: Jeanine says Marvin is cheating with co-workers and often meets up with his exes when they visit family in their hometown; he asserts that she's the one who cheated, she's insecure, and he's sick of her family picking on him. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-19

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chambers vs. Chambers
divorcecourt.us.description: Johnnie says she suspects Henri of infidelity because he acts indifferent and doesn't come home most nights; he says she's a cheater, enables her family members and has developed a gambling habit. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-20

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chambers vs. Chambers
divorcecourt.us.description: Henri and Johnnie's last attempt at rekindling their relationship in Las Vegas ended in disaster as they both were on their own most of the trip. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-21

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Schlageter vs. Johnson
divorcecourt.us.description: Kelsey says Justin cheats, doesn't pay bills and is always angry; he argues that she's a liar, and she doesn't help around the house; one of their neighbors called Kelsey and admitted that she had been sleeping with Justin for several months. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-22

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Corbitt vs. Patton
divorcecourt.us.description: Stephen says Kisha is crazy and can snap in a split second; she says he is a disrespectful mama's boy. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Cruz vs. Shissiak
divorcecourt.us.description: Billy wants Marylu to quit pole dancing and stripping; he has a fetish for wearing women's underwear, and she wants him to tell her the truth about whether he likes women, men or both. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-26

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pickering vs. Pickering
divorcecourt.us.description: Joseph says his gambling addiction, which is draining the couple's life savings, is Tamika's fault, because she is aloof from the relationship and rarely wants to have sex. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-27

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hill vs. Harris
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandon has given baby-mama Sharee a promise ring, but he hasn't promised to do a thing; he wants her to get a full-time job and not work part-time in their business. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-28

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Burton vs. Wells
divorcecourt.us.description: Barbara says she's seen Alicia's text messages from men and asserts that Alicia is verbally abusive and financially irresponsible; Alicia says Barbara refused to share her banking information and didn't pay bills, making her feel financially secure. (Reality, Law) - 2019-11-29

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Wilson vs. Wilson
divorcecourt.us.description: Michaela feels that Richard is a grumpy old man who is always talking down to her; he says he just wants to settle down and enjoy the rest of his life and says that her constant nagging is making him rethink his decision to marry her. (Reality, Law) - 2019-12-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ewing vs. Kyle
divorcecourt.us.description: Anissa and Ma'lik have been together for nine years, and they have endured a lot of heartache due to Ma'lik's cheating and dishonesty; the final straw was when her close friend became pregnant after sleeping with him. (Reality, Law) - 2019-12-03

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hamilton vs. Polk
divorcecourt.us.description: Theotis says he is tired of the constant verbal abuse from Tonesha; she says that, because of his constant cheating and non-communication, she is ready to move on with her life. (Reality, Law) - 2019-12-04

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E08 Tiff tests the BMW M5 by driving from the UK to the famous Pau circuit in France; Tom tests the Ariel Atom.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E02 Jason Plato gets a world's first test drive in the £380,000 Pagani Zonda F; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads to our Anglesey test track to race a Porsche 911 against the Lotus Exige.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson is finding out if progress has been made by Mitsubishi, as she races a classic Evo 6 against the very latest Evo 9.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson welcomes Michael Schumacher to the show, for his only British television appearance this year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E05 Tiff tests the grand tourer's handling through the dramatic scenery of Snowdonia in Wales; Jason Plato tests the brand new £115,000 Aston Martin DB9 Volante.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson tries to crack 150 mph as she makes an attempt on the Blindfolded Land Speed World Record; can Vicki hold her nerve and set a new record for driving in a straight line?

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E08 In a superb world first, Tiff Needell gets to drive a Williams Formula 1 Grand Prix car; with exclusive access to the team, follow Tiff every step of the way.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E09 Tiff Needell drives the first Porsche Cayman in the UK along the A537, known as the Cat and Fiddle Road; he evaluates whether the notoriously dangerous route can be navigated safely and enjoyably.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tom Ford puts the Bentley Continental Flying Spur to the test; we take the fastest four-door saloon in the world on a tour of Britain and see just how many swanky events Tom can visit in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson welcomes Michael Schumacher to the show, for his only British television appearance this year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: The big names of the automotive world go under the hood to discuss reviews, news and bargains of the industry.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E01 Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar; Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world; Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E02 A crash test between a Land Rover Discovery and a Renault Espace evaluates safety differences between four-by-four vehicles and multipurpose vehicles.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E04 A look at America's most glamorous car club, based in an underground bunker; Tiff and Jason race the BMW M3 against the Audi RS4.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E05 We reveal the Best Cheap Car in Britain, meet the man who's giving away a free Ferrari to try and help sell his house, and a look round the country's ultimate supercar collection.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E06 Jason Plato teaches Girls Aloud how to become racing drivers; Tiff Needell drives the new Maserati Quattroporte, and Tom Ford tries to break the world record for doing donuts in a car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns how to become a spy photographer as she goes undercover trying to snap car manufacturer's secret prototypes; Tom Ford is in Japan driving the car of the future.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E09 Find out what happens if you accidentally put diesel into a petrol engine; follow Tiff Needell as he races an Aston Martin DBR9S.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E10 Tiff Needell and Tom Ford test the new Citroën C6 by recreating the President de Gaulle assassination attempt with professional gunmen.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E11 Tom Ford flies out on Alan Sugar's private jet to test the brand new Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts a new land speed record, and Tiff Needell enters the inaugural D1GB drifting competition.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E01 Better the Devil Martin prepares to leave Portwenn when his relationship with Louisa fails; Martin's medical school girlfriend arrives.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E02 Uneasy Lies the Head Martin is unsure what to do when he hears Louisa's news, but Louisa does not want him involved; Louisa's new headmaster is exhibiting erratic behavior.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E05 The Departed The widow of one of Doc's patients believes her husband is trying to communicate from the grave; one of Louisa's students falls ill on a class trip.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E06 Midwife Crisis Doc clashes with the new district midwife over natural methods; Bert becomes enamored with a new restaurant employee.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E07 Do Not Disturb Pauline finds out Doc is leaving; Bert organizes a baby shower for Louisa; Doc and Edith go to a conference.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E08 The Wrong Goodbye Bert has another money-making scheme go wrong on Doc's last day in Portwenn, causing Louisa to go into premature labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E01 Preserve the Romance Martin Ellingham's plans to resume his career are put on hold with the birth of a baby; the new GP misdiagnoses a patient.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A soldier of fortune (Steven Seagal) seeks revenge after staging a daring jailbreak and being double-crossed. - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A chef (Jon Favreau) quits his job at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant and starts a food-truck business in Miami with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), his best friend (John Leguizamo) and his son. - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself. - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A chemist (Samuel L. Jackson) who produces illegal drugs travels to Liverpool, England, to negotiate one last deal before he retires. - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas). - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A woman (Monica Calhoun) rounds up her old gang members to take revenge on the ruthless outlaws who murdered her sister. - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after a successful assassination, a former mercenary finds himself the target of hit squads. (Entertainment) - 2015-07-01

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut, and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it. (Western, Mystery) - 1975

hdnetmovies.us.title: Windtalkers
hdnetmovies.us.description: Marine Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) is assigned to protect Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach) -- a Navajo code talker, the Marines' new secret weapon. Enders' orders are to protect his code talker, but if Yahzee should fall into enemy hands, he's to protect the code at all costs. Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code? (War, Historical drama) - 2002

hdnetmovies.us.title: Death Race 2000
hdnetmovies.us.description: In the year 2000, America is a totalitarian regime on the brink of collapse. The most popular sport in this dystopia is the Transcontinental Road Race, where teams earn points for logging the fastest time and for mowing over the most innocent pedestrians in the process. This year's competitors include Frankenstein (David Carradine), who is rumored to be more machine than man, and the tough-as-nails "Machine Gun" Joe Viterbo (Sylvester Stallone). Some have a plan to stop the race. (Action, Comedy) - 1975

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet
retroplex.us.description: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. (Crime drama) - 1990

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize. (Comedy drama) - 2007

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy
retroplex.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. classica.us.title: Chopin - Introduktion und Polonaise, Op. 3

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, op. 21
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 1. classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2021-09-24

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - 3. Sinfonie, op. 78
classica.us.description: Das Philharmonische Orchester Rotterdam spielte unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen am 20. Oktober 2018 in Rotterdam Saint-Saëns' 3. Sinfonie. Sie trägt den Beinamen "Orgelsinfonie", da dieses Instrument im zweiten und vierten Satz zu hören ist. (Special, Event, Music) - 2019-04-06

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Schumann - Violinkonzert und Sinfonie Nr. 1
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Christian Zacharias leitet das Orchestre National de Lille in einem Schumann-Konzert. Das Konzert beginnt mit der "Genoveva"-Ouvertüre, Op. 81, obwohl Schumanns einzige Oper Genoveva nicht oft aufgeführt wird. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-02-15

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen jedes Jahr die Live-Übertragung des Neujahrskonzerts. Als die Drei Tenöre anlässlich der Fußball-WM 1990 ihr legendäres Konzert in Rom gaben, sahen weltweit eine Milliarde Menschen an den Fernsehern zu. Die Dokumentation untersucht, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, klassische Musik einem breiten Publikum näherzubringen. Was dachten Herbert von Karajan und Leonard Bernstein darüber, die als einige der ersten die Möglichkeiten dieses Mediums intensiv nutzten? (Documentary) - 2012

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
classica.us.description: Fidelio, Op. 72, ist die einzige Oper von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Verfilmung aus 2018 aus dem Schweizer Theater St. Gallen basiert auf der Bühneninszenierung von Jan Schmidt-Garre. Otto Tausk dirigiert das Orchester, den Chor und die Solisten.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Berg - Klaviersonate, op. 1

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
thestandupchannel.us.description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs his most popular characters, including Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, and Bubba J, while discussing topics such as Hollywood, politics and romance.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American

thestandupchannel.us.title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated

thestandupchannel.us.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas

thestandupchannel.us.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S02 E08 Nebraska Rick and the others try to restore order after a terrible discovery; Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S02 E11 Judge, Jury, Executioner Rick sides with Shane causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity; Carl's actions have unintended consequences.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S02 E12 Better Angels When the group learns that someone dangerous may be loose near the farm, Rick, Shane, Daryl and Glenn try to keep everyone safe; Shane's antagonism grows and Carl faces the consequences of his actions.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S02 E13 Beside the Dying Fire Rick and Carl find the farm in jeopardy; the group is split up in the chaos; Rick's leadership is questioned.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E01 Seed As the world grows more dangerous and Lori's pregnancy advances, Rick locates a potentially safe haven.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E02 Sick A medical emergency proves traumatic and leaves a life hanging in the balance; Rick and the group discover a potential threat to their new surroundings.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E03 Walk With Me Andrea and Michonne witness an accident that leads them to a new group of survivors, but when tensions arise with their new acquaintances, they must make a decision.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E04 Killer Within The group becomes severed, putting lives in jeopardy; in Woodbury, Merle approaches the Governor to make a request.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E05 Say the Word Rick struggles after another loss; Michonne grows more suspicious of the Governor, who throws a party for the people of Woodbury.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E06 Hounded Andrea and the Governor grow closer while Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury; Glenn and Maggie go on a run; Rick struggles with grief.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E07 When the Dead Come Knocking A new guest at the prison forces Rick's hand; members of the group go on a mission to rescue Glenn and Maggie; the Governor presses for information.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E08 Made to Suffer Andrea steps up when the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory; a new threat arises at the prison.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E09 The Suicide King Rick tries to save one of his group; Woodbury is in disarray; new guests at the prison raise concerns.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E10 Home The group debates the next step; Rick searches for a lost friend; Daryl and Merle question their choices; the Governor restores order.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E11 I Ain't a Judas Realizing they're running out of supplies, the group must make a choice when security is threatened; Andrea goes to the prison to attempt a negotiation.

thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.title: The Walking Dead
thewalkingdeaduniverse.us.description: S03 E12 Clear Realizing they are outgunned, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons and fortify their group against the Governor and his forces.

truehistory.us.title: America's Great Trails - Pacific Crest Trail

truehistory.us.title: America's Great Trails - Hayduke Trail
truehistory.us.description: Mick journeys along the hazardous 800-mile backcountry route of the Hayduke Trail. (Travel) - 2023-08-04

truehistory.us.title: America's Great Trails - Pacific Northwest Trail
truehistory.us.description: Traveling one of the most scenic and rugged long-distance trails in the world: the 1,200-mile Pacific Northwest Trail. (Travel) - 2023-08-04

truehistory.us.title: America's Great Trails - Continental Divide Trail

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - History on a Geological Scale
truehistory.us.description: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Life Cast in Ancient Stone

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - The Lure of the City

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living
truehistory.us.description: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines. (World history) - 2014-08-29

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Meaning of Evolution
truehistory.us.description: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Way It Used to Be
truehistory.us.description: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Self-Interest, Human Survival, and History

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system. (World history) - 2016-08-28

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Kansas Flyer Buck
waypointtv.us.description: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand; everything comes together in a moment that bow hunters dream about.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : 165 Giant Buck With a Bow
waypointtv.us.description: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : Georgia Bucks Tagged Out
waypointtv.us.description: Tyler Jordan hunts his farm in Georgia and tags out on a beautiful 10-pointer using the Franchi .308.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : The Riley Green Show
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E10 Following Tyler Jordan and friends as they take a road trip around the country hunting deer, turkey and ducks!

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : New Zealand Turkey
waypointtv.us.description: Dink Watson and Sheldon Lye of New Zealand Hunting Adventures host Tyler Jordan on an unforgettable turkey hunt in New Zealand. This hunt isn't just about incredible action, it's about conservation, perception, and the future of the wild turkey.

waypointtv.us.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation : Better Than We Found It
waypointtv.us.description: Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's, addresses the care of natural resources for future generations; Ziehmer asserts it is the responsibility of citizens to leave resources in better condition for the future.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Women Go Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Morrow Ranch
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Texas Trophy Hunters Association President and CEO Christina Pittman and her husband, Matt, chase whitetails at Morrow Ranch, a go-to place for low fence Texas hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Sables
waypointtv.us.description: Texas is a land rich and plentiful, and one of the country's most sought-out destinations to hunt wild game; its hunting culture is driven by family and values, and the trophy itself is embedded within the experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Thrift Shop Goofin
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 With a laundry list of things to do on the Dirty Bird, Randy finds himself in a pickle when Cody disappears.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Mother Nature Always Wins
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 With two weeks until the opener of Missouri archery season, Randy and Cody are trying to do everything they can to have the Raven prepped for the first bow camp.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Dirt Bird
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Throwing a wrench into the plans once again with the Dirty Bird.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : Orange Free State of South Africa: White Blesbuck, Tsessebe & More
waypointtv.us.description: Mark Peterson's South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Journey Within - Eastern Cape of South Africa: Blue Duiker with Dogs
waypointtv.us.description: Join Mark Peterson as he continues his hunting journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa. In this episode, Mark takes on a unique challenge: pursuing the elusive blue duiker, one of Africa's smallest & most difficult antelope species to hunt.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : 50 Acres in 5 Days
waypointtv.us.description: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of food plots in five days; Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Raven Food Plots and Summer Work Part 2
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is still at the Raven finishing up the Big Tine plots and hanging a new set of stands in hopes of killing a buck he has his eye on come fall.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

700407.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gives more advice on tomato-growing, Nick Bailey travels to South Africa in search of the cousins of the Crocosmia, and Advolly Richmond looks at the Victorian trend of garden theme parks.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty plans for next spring when he plants some early-flowering wildflowers and gives his recipes for the different compost mixes he uses to take successful cuttings. Nick Bailey continues his quest for the South African origins of some much-loved summer bulbs, and in the heart of London, meet a keen gardener who has filled her houseboat with ornamental and edible plants.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: From giant gooseberries and growing the perfect sweet pea to flamboyant dahlias and plants pollinated by a human hair, this week Monty celebrates the plant passions of some of the extraordinary people featured on the show over the last few years.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is in his garden, catching viewers up on his new patio project and discussing his plans for the autumn. Arit Anderson travels to Somerset to meet landscape designer Dan Pearson, to find out about the design and planting principles he has used to create his own garden.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team focus their attention on the loss of wildflower habitats in the UK and the part that gardeners can play in averting the resulting loss of wildlife. Adam Frost is in Lincolnshire to find out how crucial meadows are to supporting an ecosystem.
